title: Senior Social Affiliates Manager (Marketing Brand III)
description:
¿Te apasionan los viajes, la cultura, el ocio y tienes ganas de participar en el crecimiento de la empresa Nº 1 en actividades, excursiones y tours en español por todo el mundo? Somos un equipo dinámico, multicultural e innovador, que entiende cada día como un desafío y una nueva oportunidad para crecer junto con la empresa.

En Civitatis, nuestra misión es que millones de viajeros de todo el mundo descubran y disfruten experiencias inolvidables. Serás el responsable de convertir a los creadores de contenido y afiliados en un canal de crecimiento rentable: definirás la estrategia de afiliación social, negociarás con los perfiles clave de cada mercado y responderás de su contribución en Net Revenue. Trabajarás de la mano del Head of Brand, Performance, Supply y Finance para que cada euro invertido en creadores construya marca y genere ventas medibles. Es un rol hands-on: harás tú mismo la prospección, el outreach, la negociación y la firma de creadores, con YouTube como canal principal.

En tu primer año, éxito es:

* 90 días: modelo de remuneración, contrato tipo y tracking funcionando; primeros creadores firmados en España y primeros vídeos publicados.
* 6 meses: una red de creadores activa en España y LATAM, publicando de forma constante, y un canal que ya recupera la inversión en ventas.
* 12 meses: programa activo en los 4 mercados, con contenido en español y portugués, rentabilidad creciente y un modelo self-serve en marcha para escalar con creadores más pequeños.

**¿Cómo será tu día a día?**

* **Estrategia de afiliación social:** diseñar y ejecutar la hoja de ruta de afiliación con creadores a 12–24 meses. Captar y cerrar creadores: identificar, contactar, negociar y firmar creadores por destino y mercado, priorizando YouTube (integraciones y vídeos evergreen que venden durante meses) e Instagram como canal secundario.
* **Modelos de inversión que se paguen solos:** diseñar y ajustar la remuneración (CPA, fee + comisión, incentivos por objetivos, códigos) para que cada euro invertido se recupere en NR.
* **Tracking y pagos:** asegurar que cada venta se atribuye bien (links en descripción, códigos, panel de afiliados) y que los pagos a creadores salen a tiempo y sin errores.
* **Reporting de NR:** medir y reportar NR, coste por venta y ROI por creador, mercado y formato, y decidir dónde escalar y dónde cortar.
* **Escalar el volumen:** montar el programa self-serve y los procesos que permitan llegar a la cola de creadores pequeños sin gestionarlos uno a uno.
* **Colaborarás con:** Tech (evolución del panel de afiliados y de Civitatis Creators), Supply (huecos de catálogo detectados a través de los creadores), Social y Diseño (coherencia de marca), Legal (contratos y etiquetado de contenido) y Finance (presupuesto y medición).

**¿Qué buscamos?**

* **Experiencia:** Más de 7 años de experiencia profesional, con al menos 4 años especializados en afiliación o creator marketing gestionados con objetivos directos de revenue.
* **Track record imprescindible:** Haber lanzado un programa de afiliación con creadores desde cero, aportando datos demostrables (número de creadores firmados, tiempos de ejecución y revenue generado).
* **Formación:** Titulación universitaria en Marketing, ADE o áreas similares (muy valorable formación de máster o postgrado).
* **Impacto en negocio:** Historial demostrado en la gestión y escalado de canales de afiliación con responsabilidad sobre Net Revenue (NR) o GMV propio.
* **Negociación internacional:** Experiencia negociando directamente con creadores de contenido y redes de afiliados a nivel multi-mercado.
* **Herramientas y plataformas:** Dominio de plataformas de afiliación (*Awin, Impact, CJ, Partnerize* o similares) y herramientas de gestión de creadores (*CreatorIQ, Upfluence, GRIN* o similares).
* **Conocimiento técnico:** Manejo sólido de modelos de atribución, sistemas de tracking analítico y prevención de fraude en afiliación.
* **Valoraremos muy positivamente (Plus):** Experiencia previa en el sector *travel* / OTA o *e-commerce*, así como conocimiento y gestión en mercados de LATAM.

**¿Por qué Civitatis?**

* Formarás parte del líder mundial de reserva online de excursiones y visitas guiadas en español.
* Espíritu joven, viajero y gran ambiente de trabajo. ¡+20 nacionalidades!
* Hay vida más allá del trabajo: Flexibilidad horaria (gestionas tu horario de entrada y salida), jornada intensiva en verano, modalidad de trabajo híbrida, así como otras medidas de conciliación.
* ¡24 días laborables de vacaciones! ¿Necesitas más descanso o tiempo para ti? Con Cividías, puedes comprar días extra de vacaciones cada año.
* Eventos de teambuilding (afterworks, torneos de pádel, fútbol, tours, fiestas, concursos, etc.)
* Planes voluntarios de retribución flexible para sacar el máximo partido a tu salario.
* ¡Equipo sano, equipo feliz! Tenemos fruta siempre a mano en la oficina y co-financiamos el gimnasio‍️.
* Nunca dejarás de aprender: planes de desarrollo, formación continua y clases de inglés con profesores nativos.
* Podrás disfrutar de nuestras más de 90.500 actividades con un super descuento.
* Trabajarás en el corazón de Madrid. Oficinas en plena Gran Vía.
* En Civitatis impulsamos la diversidad y la igualdad de oportunidades, valorando el talento y el potencial de cada persona. Esta oferta está abierta a todas las personas que cumplan con el perfil profesional requerido.

title: Senior Ads Measurement Partner

Netflix Ads in Spain has seen amazing growth since its launch, and there has never been a more exciting time to get involved.

Netflix’s Ads Spain Measurement team is looking for a new Ads Measurement Lead to join the team. If you are someone who has experience taking independent action, demonstrating strong attention to detail, and working effectively in a collaborative environment, Netflix may be the place for you. * At least 6 years of experience in media research at a streaming, agency, advertiser, or digital media company.
* Strong understanding of methodology, data, and systems from research providers, as well as direct digital technology and analytics.
* Experienced in effectiveness measurements such as Reach & Frequency, Incremental lift, Brand lift, Matched-Market testing, A/B testing, Marketing Mix Models and bespoke campaign effectiveness studies.

* Strong knowledge of the advertising landscape, across all kinds of media channels and methods of buying.

* Knowledge in advertising for Live events.
* Experience managing projects independently with a high attention to detail.
* Experience in building and following processes to make working methods more efficient.
* Experience navigating early-stage environments with ambiguity.
* Demonstrated ability to build strong relationships with clients and colleagues, valuing diverse perspectives for better decision-making.
* Demonstrated ability to investigate and interpret data meaning.

title: Senior FX Product Manager - Hedging Conversion
description:
Ebury helps ambitious businesses unlock global growth, and we take the same approach with our people. We encourage innovation and movement, collaboration and problem-solving, and foster an environment where everyone can feel they belong, are valued, supported and empowered to succeed.

If you're a collaborator who wants to help transform how businesses operate globally, get in touch - we'd love to discuss how Ebury can accelerate your career so you can shape the future.

**FX Senior Product Manager - Hedging conversion**

**Ebury Madrid Office - Hybrid: 4 days in the office, 1 day working from home per week**

As Ebury scales globally, we are evolving from a delivery-led organisation into a **platform-led product** company - building shared foundations that allow teams to move faster, operate safely in regulated environments and deliver high-quality client experiences across channel

**The Opportunity**

We're looking for a **Senior Product Manager** to own one number: the share of Ebury's clients who convert into hedgers — and to build the journeys, workflows and decision tools that get them there.

Ebury has a real hedging business. Thousands of clients already hedge with us, they're our most valuable and stickiest, and Hedge works. The problem isn't proof of concept — it's rate. For every client who converts, several more carry the same currency exposure, would benefit from the same forward, and never get there.

Here's the honest reason why. Hedging isn't a product you sell; it's a conclusion a client reaches once they can see what their international business is actually exposed to. Today that seeing happens in a CPM's head and a spreadsheet, one client at a time. The client can't see their own exposure clearly, the CPM can't see it at scale, and so the conversation that should be obvious either happens late or never happens at all.

This role builds the layer that changes that: guided journeys and lifecycle workflows that carry a client from unaware exposure to a first hedge to a standing policy — and the decision tools that let both the client and their CPM understand the client's international business well enough to make the right call, not just the next call.

You'll sit at the intersection of product, data, and commercial, working closely with:

* CPMs and Sales teams who convert clients today
* Data and Analytics
* Design and Engineering
* Compliance and Risk
* Clients directly

**What you'll do**

You will own the end-to-end conversion journey into hedging, backed by a dedicated squad of developers, including:

**Journeys & Lifecycle Workflows**

* The path from spot client Hedge-active policy client, and every drop-off point along it
* Guided, staged journeys rather than one-off prompts: the right message, to the right client, at the moment their exposure is real to them
* Triggered workflows off real events, a new currency pair, a large invoice, a rate move against them, a forward maturing
* Understanding what separates the clients who convert from the ones who don't, and building for the difference

**Decision Tools for Clients**

* Showing a client what their international business is actually exposed to, in their own numbers and their own currencies
* Exposure views, scenario and impact modelling, MTM and forward comparisons a finance lead can act on without training
* Turning "should I hedge?" into a question the client can answer for themselves, with confidence
* Balancing honesty about risk against simplicity of decision, the goal is a well-made decision, not a sold one

**Tooling for CPMs**

* Giving CPMs a portfolio-level view of client exposure, trades and performance, so they know who to talk to and what to say before the client asks
* Surfacing the signals that make a conversation timely: unhedged exposure, changing trade patterns, policy lapses
* Learning from the conversations that already convert clients, and productising them

**Repeat Hedging & Policy**

* Turning a first hedge into a second and a third
* Moving clients from ad-hoc trades onto a standing hedging policy they run every month
* Statements, notifications and review moments that build the habit and prove the value after the fact

**Experimentation & Measurement**

* A cadence of A/B tests across the journey, not a feature backlog
* Reading results honestly, including the ones that kill your own ideas
* Building the measurement so conversion, and what's driving it

**What success looks like (12-18 months)**

* Spot-to-hedger conversion rate is measurably higher, and you can attribute the lift
* A meaningful share of new hedgers convert through product journeys rather than a CPM conversation
* CPMs work from exposure signals in a tool instead of instinct and spreadsheets, and cover more clients as a result
* Clients can articulate their own FX exposure — and clients who hedge once come back without being called
* More hedgers move onto hedging policies rather than trading ad hoc
* Product — not people — becomes the primary driver of hedging conversion

**What makes this role hard**

* You're changing behaviour, not shipping features. The instrument already exists and works; the reason more clients don't use it is understanding, trust and habit.
* It's a two-sided problem. Clients and CPMs need different views of the same truth, and building for one badly makes the other worse but the CPMs must know what the client can see to have consultative conversations
* The baseline isn't zero. There's an existing business and an existing way of converting clients, you have to improve on it without disrupting it.
* Exposure is genuinely hard to model. Client data is incomplete, trade history is a proxy for intent, and being confidently wrong about someone's exposure destroys trust instantly.
* You're helping non-experts make decisions with real financial consequences. Oversimplify and you mislead; don't simplify and nobody acts.
* You'll navigate real-world complexity: regional and regulatory nuance, credit and margin implications, and client segments with genuinely different needs.

**Who we are looking for**

Prior FX or hedging experience is a plus, not a requirement. We're looking for someone who can move a hard conversion number in a complex, regulated environment — with strong agency, sharp analytical instincts, and a real feel for why people do and don't act.

**Must-have:**

* 4+ years of product management experience, including at least one role owning conversion, adoption or engagement outcomes end-to-end
* Strong analytics and experimentation skills — funnel analysis, cohort and retention analysis, designing and interpreting A/B tests
* Experience designing lifecycle journeys or triggered workflows, and the messaging that carries them
* Fluent English (daily collaboration with global commercial, tech and Legal/Compliance/Risk stakeholders)

**Nice-to-have:**

* Familiarity with foreign exchange, hedging or other asset classes
* Experience in fintech or regulated financial products
* Experience building internal or advisor-facing tooling alongside client-facing product
* Localisation awareness

**Core Capabilities**

* **Strong Product Fundamentals** — breaks down ambiguous problems into clear product opportunities; comfortable working across UX, data and operations; focused on outcomes, not just delivery.
* **Funnel & Journey Thinking** — instinctively looks for where clients fall out and why; designs staged journeys rather than isolated features; sizes the opportunity before designing the fix.
* **Two-Sided Design** — builds for clients and the internal teams serving them at once; understands the trade-offs between automation and human judgement.
* **Behavioural Instinct** — thinks in triggers, incentives and habit loops; understands that conversion is earned, not shipped.
* **Analytical Depth** — partners with Data rather than outsourcing the thinking; can build the exposure and funnel view themselves and defend it.
* **Commercial Awareness** — understands how product decisions land in revenue and margin; prioritises on business impact, not just user feedback.
* **High Agency & Pragmatism** — comfortable operating in under-defined environments; bias to action; doesn't wait for perfect structure.
* **Deep Customer Curiosity** — regularly speaks to clients and CPMs; uses it to inform decisions, not just validate them.

**Why Ebury?**

* **Competitive Starting Salary** with an **annual discretionary bonus**that truly rewards your performance from day one.
* **Dedicated Mentorship:** Learn directly from experienced managers who are invested in your success.
* **Cutting-Edge Technology:** Leverage state-of-the-art tailor made tools and systems that enable you to perform at your best.

* **Central** **Madrid** **Office: A fantastic location with excellent transport links.**

You can also connect with me on LinkedIn - Fabienne Zigrit

* The ability to explain technical decisions clearly to engineers and non-engineers alike.
* A history of improving how a team works. There is a practice, tool or workflow that exists, or was killed, because of you.
* Clear, direct communication in English, written and spoken.

**Things to elevate your application**
--------------------------------------

* Paradox grand strategy experience, Europa Universalis especially. Genuine interest in the genre matters more than logged hours.
* Experience on a live title with a recurring update cadence.
* Experience working with a large, long-lived codebase.

**The Studio**
--------------

Paradox Tinto was founded in 2020 by a small and dedicated team of industry veterans led by Johan Andersson, and building on our experience from Paradox Interactive and Paradox Development Studio, we develop Europa Universalis V, the latest entry in the grand strategy franchise that started it all more than twenty-five years ago.

**The Team**
------------

At Paradox Tinto we work in a small, gameplay focused team, where everyone is part of crafting the player experience and has input on the design of the game. We believe game development should be fun, and we strive for a relaxed, stress-free atmosphere. Being a small studio built from the ground up, we expect everyone to contribute to the development of the studio and its culture. We are also proud of having accessible, experienced managers who lead you and care about you. Your contributions matter to us, to the whole studio, and to the games we make. You will be close to the final product, our community and our fans. We will encourage you to interact with our players directly through social media, our forum, and via streams. Work/life balance matters to us, so our development plans do not rely on crunch. This does not mean we never work overtime, but overtime is relatively uncommon and not encouraged.

**The Location**
----------------

Our office is 300m from one of the beaches of Sitges, a picturesque Mediterranean coastal city. It is well connected by public transport and within walking distance of restaurants, bars, pharmacies, supermarkets, shops and hotels. Sitges is barely 20 minutes by car or bus from El Prat, Barcelona's international airport. It offers 17 beaches along its own coastline, the Costa del Garraf, and an average of 300 days of sun a year, which is hard to argue with for outdoor sports and weekends. Mountain lovers still have the Pyrenees, only a two hour drive away. The town will also captivate you with its cultural events, Mediterranean food and, of course, excellent Spanish wine.

**Some of our benefits**
------------------------

* 25 working days of vacation per year (23 per the collective agreement, plus 2 extra)
* Private health insurance
* Wellhub subscription: gym access and digital wellbeing apps
* A private gym at the office, plus optional free yoga and HIIT sessions
* Cobee by Pluxee flexible compensation, letting you allocate part of your gross salary to meals or public transport
* Free access to the full Paradox catalogue on Steam, over 100 games
* Healthy snacks and soft drinks, a private garden, and regular team activities

If you think this description matches you, we encourage you to apply as soon as possible, as we interview candidates continuously. If you don't match all the requirements, tell us how your passion, attitude and interest in Paradox might compensate.

At Paradox Interactive we celebrate difference and care deeply about diversity and inclusion. We therefore encourage you, no matter who you are, to apply for this job if you think you'd be a great addition to our team.

**Practical information**
-------------------------

Scope: Full-time and permanent

Location: Sitges, Barcelona (Spain)

WFH/WFO: 100% onsite

Reports to: Head of Operations

A position for a Data Integration Solution Architect has just arised within Airbus Defence & Space in Getafe. The successful candidate will join Data Integration team which is part of AD&S Data Management & AI. As a Data Integration Solution Architect you will design and architect the data solutions that connect different data sources from any existing repository or information system across the entire organization, in alignment with standards defined by Enterprise Architecture and compliance and regulatory requirements

  

The successful candidate will work alongside a multi-disciplinary team of data roles, including data engineers, dataops engineers, and other data architects, working in classical and agile project management methodologies, to guide the projects to select the most appropriate data pattern to connect the involved data in the most standard and sustainable approach.

  

Additionally, will support the head of the function, jointly with other Data Integration Solution architects, on the strategical vision of new Data Integration & Interoperability layer at company level, to leverage the AI acceleration

  

You will make the data fly inside Airbus Defence & Space and also from and to outside partners, customers or governments!

* Define solution architecture linked to all Data Integration demands/requests once the product owner shared the functional and technical needs of the new Use Case
* Support Data Architecture sustainability thanks to standard architecture patterns, blocks and artifacts per Data Integration product

* Provide guidelines to the DevOps Tool Owner and Operation Managers on the different architecture configurations
* Secure that all TD Security standards are taken into account by new Projects/Demands of Data Integration

Track the major upgrades of Data Integration products and advise Service team on how to implement the upgrade

* SABBs/SBBs Security standards up to date
* Security products in Data Integration landscape properly configured and aligned with standards and Enterprise Architecture guidelines

title: Regional People Partner - Europe Major Markets
description:
### **Description**

**Diversity matters**

We are building a brand that represents the people of the world. It’s what you do that counts, and we are always looking to expand perspectives and voices to shape our future.

We see you, we celebrate you, we want you!

**Who we are**  
You might know us as the inventors of the bath bomb, but there’s more to this great-smelling, partly employee-owned, family-run company than pioneering cosmetics. We believe our business should put more back into the world than it takes and demonstrate that capitalism can be a force for good.  
  
The Living Wage Foundation’s statement 'a hard day's work deserves a fair day's pay' is one that we are proud to commit to in the UK. As an accredited Living Wage employer, we put our people first and fight cruel practices like animal testing, promote regeneration, and show that it is what’s inside that counts - whether that’s an ingredient in a product, or the minerals in a smartphone.  
  
Want to see where a career at Lush could take you? Head over here to explore real stories of growth and development across the business.  
  
Lush is committed to pay transparency and equal pay for equal work or work of equal value. Pay decisions are made objectively based on role scope, geographic market data, experience, and capability, without regard to gender or protected characteristics.  
  
**Role overview:**

Develop meaningful and mutually beneficial relationships between people practices and commercial business success across our European major markets. Engage with regional leaders, country managers, and business partners. Deliver change and transformation, taking the lead in people related projects with a broad and objective view of the impact across diverse business areas and geographies within the region.

This role involves direct line management and leadership of People Leads across our European entities. Driving regional alignment, operational consistency, and team development. You will utilise sound knowledge of Lush people principles and best practices, working collaboratively and proactively with other members of the global and regional people team on cross functional projects, in support of colleagues doing their best work across multiple markets.

**Office Location:** This role will support our colleagues in France, Germany, Italy and Spain and ideally you're main location of work will be Paris, Berlin, Milan or Madrid.

**Business Travel:** As this role will be supporting France, Germany, Italy and Spain, travelling will be a requirement.  
  
**Please note: We may close this vacancy early if we receive an overwhelming response or our business requirements change.**

  

### **Key Responsibilities**

  

* Directly line manage and empower the People Leads across European entities, fostering their growth, setting clear operational standards, and ensuring strong local HR delivery.
* Work alongside the Leader/Director, FBP, and their team on a wide range of topics, such as change management, projects, organisational design, recruitment, training and development, and communications.
* Provide tactical advice and guidance to the management of your business areas on all people matters relating to capability, skills required, and performance output.
* Connect regularly with the People Discipline Leads creating alignment in standards of staff experience in recruitment, onboarding, training, pay, and development while respecting and adapting to local cultural and regulatory nuances within the region.
* Deliver organisational development projects and support organisational change initiatives within the business entities. Establishing needs, proposing solutions, and monitoring effectiveness to get the best possible return for the business area while managing regional complexity and local implementation.
* Navigate local employment law landscapes across major markets, partnering with local experts and employee representative bodies such as Works Councils and Trade Unions to ensure fair, compliant, and culturally sensitive operations.
* Build relationships of mutual learning and trust with regional peers and stakeholders and have a good understanding of individuals' working styles and team dynamics.
* Assess and review team structures & development pathways. Identify skills gaps, succession planning, talent, and performance management opportunities across your team and European entities.
* Clearly communicate guidance to staff at all levels on change management and restructures, with emphasis on the how, ensuring compliance with all relevant jurisdictional requirements by working with local experts.
* Proactively anticipate issues before they happen and act for prevention, particularly regarding cross border people movement and regulatory changes across European markets.

  

### **Skills, Knowledge and Expertise**

  

* Minimum of 5 years of HR/People Partnering experience, ideally within a multi site retail, commercial, or multinational environment.
* Proven track record in line managing, coaching, and developing HR/People leads across international or multi entity business models.
* Broad understanding of the commercial landscape within Europe with a drive to help others understand it too.
* Solid working knowledge of French employment law is highly beneficial. Familiarity with employment law in other key European markets is desirable, though core knowledge across other jurisdictions can be taught and supported by local specialists.
* Experience in, or strong capability to navigate:
  + Works Councils (Comité Social et Économique / Betriebsrat) in France and Germany.
  + Trade Unions & Collective Bargaining Agreements (CBA / CCN) in Spain and Italy (e.g., *Convenio Colectivo*, *Contratto Collettivo Nazionale di Lavoro*).
* Trusted relationship with the Director/s, with a track record of providing useful advice and recommendations on people matters.
* Act with kindness, integrity, and respect.
* Strong analytical and problem solving skills, with the ability to make decisions independently.
* Informed, relevant, and up to date with the business and team sentiment across the region.
* High emotional intelligence with the ability to think quickly and sensitively in a culturally diverse environment.
* Demonstrable ability to influence, challenge, and negotiate with management at all levels and execute with excellence.
* Excellent ability to navigate multiple perspectives and stakeholders to deliver action that works for everyone.
* Desire to represent a professional and fair approach.
* Strong ability to constantly assess and prioritise the needs of the business and individuals.
* Positive attitude, motivated, action oriented.
* Able to support the growth and development of individuals at all levels.
* Competent in recruiting, interviewing, career conversations in addition to performance management, sensitive feedback, or exit conversations.
* Commercially minded, analytical, and objective, with a strong grasp of regional market data and trends.
* Collaborate closely with other People disciplines to ensure support for all employees, including Talent, Global Mobility, Pay and Benefits, ED&I, People Support, and L&D.

**Languages**

* Professional fluency in spoken and written English is required.
* Professional fluency in one or more major European languages (French, German, Spanish, or Italian) is strongly preferred to effectively manage localised People Leads and partner with regional stakeholders across key entities.

  

### **Benefits**

  

* Bonus scheme
* Day off for weekday birthdays
* A generous discount on Lush products and spa treatments
* Employee assistance programme
* We’re 10% Employee Owned - all colleagues play a role in protecting our ethics, our independence, contributing ideas for the future and share in the rewards of success when the company is doing well.
* Access to employee-led Community Networks, including Disability and Chronic Illness, Family Support, Global Majority (Race and Ethnicity), LGBTQIA+, Menopause and Neurodiversity communities.

Localised benefits can be discussed in more detail during the recruitment process.

We believe that your information is yours and that it is Lush's responsibility to process your personal information in a secure, fair and accurate manner. Every individual processed by LUSH has certain rights over their data, which are detailed in our Privacy Notice here.

### **About Lush**

Since establishing in 1995 in Poole, Dorset, Lush has been driven by innovation and its ethics.  
Creators of pioneering beauty products such as the fizzing bath bomb, shower jellies and solid shampoo bars, we place emphasis on fresh ingredients like organic fruits and vegetables, fight against animal testing and combat over-packaging by developing products that can be sold ‘naked’ to the customer without any packaging.  
  
We currently operate in 52 countries with 928 global shops. Through our separate business divisions we invent, manufacture and sell our handmade products direct to our customers through our own shops and online. The fact that we make all our products by hand is something we are really rather proud of!  
  
Lush is 10% Employee Owned since 2017 and our people are the heart and soul of our business.

Founded by sisters Louisa and Rebecca, Regalrose is a British-born ecommerce jewellery retailer with over 15 years in business. Specialising in uniquely designed jewellery and accessories with a fierce edge and dreamy-dark twist, Regalrose is going from strength to strength as demonstrated by our exceptional growth over the last few years. **About You**

You will be a driven, self-motivated marketing leader with at least 8 years’ experience in a similar role, ideally in e-commerce or retail. title: Director of Brand & Communications
description:
A
**profitable DTC pet brand doing $50M+ a year, scaling to $100M+, fully remote**
is looking for a
**Head of Brand & Community**
to join our team! You will own how people see and feel about our two brands: the brand story and identity, and the brand moments that build awareness and goodwill, including shelter and charity partnerships, activations and events, PR and community.
  
  
We are looking for someone who has
**done it before**
and really understands building a brand: creating brand moments and knowing how to actually make them happen, so we build our brand and brand awareness from the ground up. The ideal candidate has
**7+ years**
in brand, communications or brand marketing at consumer brands, a track record of building awareness through cause partnerships, events and PR, and has run campaigns for a North American audience.
  
  
**The mission of this role**
Make our brands the most loved and trusted pet brands in North America, not just the most bought. You will own how people see and feel about our brands: a clear brand story and identity used everywhere, and the brand moments that build awareness and goodwill, including shelter and charity partnerships, activations and events, PR and community. Success is more people searching for us by name, more customers coming from word of mouth, more earned press, and a giving-back program customers know us for.
  
  
**Who are we?**
We're a profitable DTC pet brand selling premium stainless steel cat water fountains, filters and accessories. We sell across Shopify, Amazon and Chewy, and we're one of the fastest-growing brands in the pet space - $50M+ in annual revenue and scaling to $100M+. We recently launched a dog brand, expanding into an entirely new vertical and customer base. We're a 100% remote, lean, senior team that moves fast, and every person here has a massive impact on the business.
  
  
**What is our culture like & who is a good fit?**
Culture-fit is our #1 factor when hiring! We have a genuine will-to-win. No work is beneath us if it moves us towards our goals. We use creativity to do more with less - and quickly. We use data to make decisions and live by four core values:
  
  

* Better Everyday: review every brand moment against its goal, and make the next one bigger, cheaper or better
* Speed Is King: jump on cultural moments and press opportunities the same day, and launch every brand moment on schedule
* Work Smart: use partners, agencies and AI instead of a large team. For example, use Claude to draft press pitches and partner outreach, track media mentions, turn reviews into customer stories, and build the monthly brand-health report from search, survey and press data
* Overdeliver: bring the CEO new partnership and brand-moment ideas before being asked, and get more press and goodwill from each moment than the plan called for

**If you want a stress-free corporate 9-5 job, this isn't it.**
If you want to challenge yourself and shape a fast-growing company, work directly with the founder, and play a big role in scaling it to $100M+... If you want to drive results with a group of passionate, smart, hardworking people, in an environment without politics or corporate chicanery, being hands-on and active - then you've come to the right place.
  
  
**Outcomes (what Success Looks Like)**
*90-day targets for each outcome are agreed with you before your start date.*

* More people know and search for our brands: branded search volume and direct traffic, monthly vs the same month last year
* More new customers come from word of mouth and press: share of new customers who say friend, family, press or social (not an ad) in the post-purchase survey
* We earn press and attention: earned media mentions and their reach each quarter, including press from each brand moment
* Our giving-back program makes a real, visible impact: shelters partnered, pets helped, and product and dollars donated each quarter, shown on the website
* The brand looks and sounds the same everywhere: quarterly brand audit across website, packaging, ads, email and social

**Key Objectives**

* Own the brand story, positioning, tone of voice and brand guidelines for both brands, and keep the two brands distinct
* Design and run a giving-back program with shelter and rescue partners that customers know us for, and track its impact
* Build the yearly brand-moment calendar and run each moment end to end: concept, partners, budget, website and email, social and creators, and press
* Run pop-ups, events, sponsorships and stunts, each with its own budget and goal
* Win earned media: pitch every brand moment, cause campaign and launch, directly or through a PR agency you manage
* Build a super-fan community and turn customer reviews, photos and stories into brand content
* Report brand health monthly and own the brand budget

**Requirements**

* Fully remote, full-time, based in Mexico, Ukraine or Brazil
* Fluent in English
* Brand Experience: 7+ years in brand, communications or brand marketing at consumer brands is ideal; 5-6 years with strong results is also considered
* Brand Builder: You have built awareness and goodwill for a consumer brand through causes, events and PR, not just design, ideally from an early stage
* Brand Moments: You have planned and shipped brand moments end to end, on time and on budget, across many partners
* Cause Marketing: You have run nonprofit or shelter partnerships that were real, measured and credible, not a logo on a page
* PR & Storytelling: You turn a moment into a story that press and customers repeat, and you have the press wins to show for it
* North America: You have run campaigns for a North American audience, and can run events and partners there remotely through agencies, partners and local contractors
* Brand Taste: A sharp eye for what is on-brand, and you protect consistency across every touchpoint
* Commercial Mindset: You tie brand work to measurable results like branded search, word of mouth and press
* No issue working overtime or on the weekends if needed. You are passionate about your work
* Excellent cultural fit as per our values above
* Excited to play a big role in scaling the company and work closely with the founder
* Bonus points: pet industry experience

**Accountabilities**
*What you own. Each one is checked green, yellow or red every week.*

* Brand foundation and guidelines: Own the brand story, guidelines and asset library for both brands, review new pages, packaging, emails and key ads before they go live, and run a quarterly brand audit across every touchpoint
* Cause and shelter partnerships: Choose each brand's anchor causes with the CEO, sign and manage national and local shelter and rescue partners, run adoption events and donation drives, and track and report the impact
* Brand moments and activations: Build the yearly brand-moment calendar (National Cat Day, National Dog Day, Clear the Shelters, Giving Tuesday and our own owned moment), run each one end to end, and hand its story and assets to the growth and creator teams
* PR and earned media: Pitch press and podcasts directly or through a PR agency you manage, win reviews, gift-guide placements and awards, keep the press kit current, and track every mention
* Community and customer stories: Turn reviews, photos and stories into brand content, build a super-fan community with surprise-and-delight moments, and make the website show the brand properly
* Brand reporting and budget: Report brand health monthly, own the brand budget (events, donations, PR, sponsorships), set monthly Rocks with the CEO, and write SOPs so the playbook works without one person

**How Our Hiring Works & How We Operate**

* Application + Screening Interview
* In-Depth Interview with the CEO
* Reference Calls
* Final In-Depth Interview with the CEO

**Salary Expectation**
**US$45,000-70,000 base per year**
(based on experience and expertise), plus a bonus of 10-20% of base.

**Job Description**
Location: 100% Remote

THE ROLE
  
  
You will work with M&P Partners.
  
  
We are looking for a highly creative, tech-expert Marketing Manager to take our companies and brands to the next level. You will be the hands-on "doer" working directly under our Marketing Lead, turning ideas into finished content, campaigns and creatives across our portfolio of brands, starting with a medical aesthetics brand, then expanding to a consulting business and the founder's personal brand.
  
  
We already have a large library of existing content. A big part of this role is getting creative with what we already have: repurposing, editing, packaging and publishing it so it performs. This is not a strategy-only seat. We need someone who gets their hands dirty, is very creative, and also gets a lot done.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Content Creation: Create new content from our existing content library (short-form video, reels, carousels, posts, graphics) for each brand
* Posting & Channel Management: Schedule, publish and manage content across social channels (Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, YouTube, LinkedIn and others as needed)
* Email Marketing: Write and build emails and campaigns. The Marketing Lead provides ideation and final review; you own the writing, building and execution
* Ad & Marketing Creatives: Come up with and produce creatives for paid ads and marketing campaigns (statics, video concepts, hooks, copy)
* Content Production Management: Manage the content pipeline end to end, making sure raw footage gets to editors, edits get done on time, and quality is maintained
* Tech & Tools: Own the marketing tech stack: scheduling tools, design and editing software, email platforms, CRMs and AI tools. Set things up, troubleshoot and keep them running
* AI Integration: Use AI tools to scale output (copy, scripts, image and video assets) without sacrificing brand voice
* Multi-Brand Execution: Start with the medical aesthetics brand, then expand the same system to the consulting business and the founder's personal brand
* Reporting: Track what's working (engagement, reach, email and ad metrics) and share short weekly updates with the Marketing Lead

TIME & LOCATION
  
  

* Full-Time (40 hrs/week), with an immediate start upon hire
* 100% remote. You will need a quiet workspace with fast internet, a webcam and a microphone for video calls
* Must be able to accommodate different schedules and time zones

**Requirements**
WHAT YOU NEED
  
  

* Very Creative: A strong eye for content, design and hooks. You can look at existing footage and see five new pieces of content
* Doer Mentality: Proven track record of executing at high volume. You don't wait for instructions to get things done
* Content & Social Experience: 2+ years creating and posting content and managing social channels for brands, ideally across multiple brands at once
* Ad Creative Experience: Experience coming up with creatives for paid social (Meta, TikTok or YouTube ads)
* Email Copywriting: Strong writing skills to turn ideas into polished emails and captions
* Project Management: Highly organized and "tight" on details. Able to keep editors and deadlines on track
* Advanced English Level: Exceptional written and spoken communication is mandatory

**What Makes You Stand Out**

* Experience marketing a medical aesthetics, med spa, beauty or wellness brand
* Experience growing a founder or CEO personal brand
* Experience with consulting or B2B services marketing
* Hands-on video editing skills
* A portfolio of content, creatives and campaigns you've produced

**Benefits**
COMPENSATION & BENEFITS
  
  

* Competitive salary, based on experience
* Remote work year-round
* 25 PTO days per year
* 9 National Holidays
* Professional development and continuous growth
* High autonomy and ownership over your projects across multiple brands

Note: If you don't think you meet all the criteria but are still interested in the job, please apply. Nobody checks every box. We prioritize flexible candidates willing to learn and grow professionally.

title: Head Of Product UX And Design Product Owners Experience And Creative
description:
**Job Description**
Company Description
  
  
Our Client is a real estate developer creating AI-native, agentic homes and workplaces, with an intelligent agent that learns its occupants and adapts the environment toward wellness and longevity. Their approach is built around the idea that a smart home should know you, care for you and make you healthier over time, not just act as a remote control on an app.
  
  
Our Client runs a lab and experience centre where products are tested with real residents and office users, and has a pipeline of thousands of units to deploy into. Our Client is a fast-moving, founder-led organisation, with a mandate to set a new design standard for the industry.
  
  
**Job Description**
Role Overview
  
  
We are seeking an exceptional Head of Product, UX & Design to own what our client builds and how it feels. The client is creating AI-native, agentic homes and workplaces, spaces with an intelligent agent that learns their occupants and continuously adapts the environment toward wellness and longevity.
  
  
Reporting to the Chief AI Officer (CAIO), you will lead all product owners, product managers, designers and creative talent. You will turn the CAIO’s vision into clear product roadmaps and an unmistakably premium experience across every touchpoint: the super app, wall switches, smart mirrors, voice, a 3D AI agent, and the physical spaces themselves.
  
  
We are looking for a design superhero with product leadership depth: someone of the calibre found at Apple, Uber, Noon, Swiggy, Revolut or leading health-tech companies. You must hold a very high bar, and be confident enough to push back when something isn’t good enough.
  
  
Reporting & Team
  
  
Reports to: Chief AI Officer (CAIO)
  
  
Key partners: Head of Technology (engineering delivery); Technical Program Manager; Marketing & Brand (including external brand agencies); Sales & Go-to-Market
  
  
**Leads:**

* Product owners: Agentic Intelligence, PWA / Super App, Hardware & IoT. Each owns their product end to end and partners day to day with the Head of Technology’s engineering teams.
* Product management: Product Managers and Product Associates reporting into each product owner
* UX Design: UX Design Manager, Product Designers, UX/UI Designers
* Creative & Graphics: Graphic Design Manager, Senior Graphic Designer, Motion Graphics Designer

Key Responsibilities Requirements
  
  

* Product Leadership & Roadmap
* Own the product strategy and roadmap across the client’s three product lines: the agentic intelligence layer, the PWA / super app, and the hardware & IoT experience.
* Lead and grow the product owners, giving each a clear mandate, outcomes and accountability for delivering a complete, working product with their engineering counterparts.
* Turn the CAIO’s vision into prioritised, sequenced roadmaps that balance residential first (the current priority), commercial workplaces, and later hospitality.
* Define success metrics and run the product cadence (discovery, PRDs, sprint reviews, launch readiness) together with the Technical Program Manager.
* The Super App & Customer Journey
* Own the end-to-end journey in the PWA, evolving it into the super app for agentic living:

+ Pre-sales: an AI-guided digital brochure, delivered through brokers, that helps buyers choose an apartment and its customisations.
+ Onboarding: the resident “interviews” their home agent, building their profile, preferences and household setup (with privacy between family members).
+ Handover: construction updates, fit-out choices and move-in readiness.
+ Living: daily control and wellness insights, plus communicating with the home from anywhere.

* Design for multiple modalities (chat, voice, a 3D/avatar agent and touch) while keeping the experience simple for people who don’t want to “talk to AI”.
* UX, Interaction & Design Systems
* Build and own the design system across app, web, wall switches, smart mirrors, tablets and in-space displays.
* Define the interaction language for ambient, mostly invisible automation: how the space shows what it is doing, what it detected, and how the occupant can override it.
* Champion research and usability testing with real residents and office users in the lab and Experience Centre.
* Set and protect a world-class quality bar for micro-interactions, motion and polish.
* Creative Direction & Brand Expression
* Lead the creative and graphics team: visual design, motion graphics, product storyboards and sales/marketing assets.
* Partner with Marketing and the brand agency so that the brand direction (bold and colourful, “Nike meets Apple”, glassmorphism and neumorphism, biophilic cues) shows up consistently in the product.
* Produce product vision videos and prototypes that make an invisible, passive experience visible and compelling to investors, buyers and partners.
* Wellness, Data & Trust
* Translate biometric and wellness data (from wearables such as Whoop, Oura and Ultrahuman, and from in-space sensing) into insights and nudges people actually act on, without being creepy.
* Make privacy and consent a first-class part of the experience, working with the Head of Technology on privacy-by-design.

Product & Design Leadership Requirements
  
  

* Product Leadership: Product strategy, roadmapping, OKRs, managing product owners/managers, outcome-based prioritisation
* UX & Interaction: Multi-platform UX (mobile, web/PWA, embedded displays), conversational and voice UX, prototyping, user research
* Visual & Creative: Design systems, typography, motion design, brand-to-product translation; strong portfolio required
* AI Product Literacy: Understanding of LLMs and agents, and how to design trustworthy, explainable AI experiences
* Tooling: Figma (expert), prototyping tools (ProtoPie, Framer or similar), After Effects/motion tooling, analytics platforms
* Collaboration: Proven partnership with engineering leadership; experience working with external agencies
* Leadership: Built and led combined product + design teams of 10+; hiring and mentoring across seniority levels

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Hardware-Adjacent Products: Experience designing products that extend beyond the screen into smart home, IoT, wearables, automotive or connected devices.
* Health/Wellness Tech: Product or design leadership at a health-tech or wearables company (e.g. Whoop, Oura, Ultrahuman, Eight Sleep) is a strong plus.
* Consumer Super Apps: Experience at companies known for design excellence and complex consumer journeys (e.g. Apple, Uber, Careem, Noon, Swiggy, Revolut).
* Zero-to-One Experience: You have built a product and a team from scratch, not just optimised an existing one.
* Strong Opinions, Loosely Held: You will push back on a bad idea, including the CEO’s, and change your mind when the evidence says so.

Why This Role?
  
  
Most real-estate “smart homes” are a remote control on an app. Our client is building something different: homes and workplaces that know you, care for you and make you healthier over time. You will define the face, voice and feel of that intelligence, from the first time a buyer meets the client’s agent on a broker’s tablet to the moment a resident’s bathroom mirror suggests a better night’s sleep. You will have the mandate, the team and the executive support to set a new design standard for the industry.
  
  
Additional Suggestions for the Candidate
  
  

* Portfolio Is Everything: Please include case studies that show product thinking and craft, ideally including motion and multi-device work.
* Think Beyond the Screen: Come ready to discuss how you would design an experience where the best interaction is often no interaction at all.
* Bring a Point of View: Tell us one thing you would change about how today’s smart home apps work, and how you would do it better.
* Offered Salary: Competitive, in line with market standards for the role and seniority, along with additional benefits as per the company’s band structure.

title: Director of Creative Performance
description:
**Department:** Marketing

**Reports To:** Head of Growth

**Employment Type:** Full-Time

**Location:** Remote

**Base Salary:** $170,000–$190,000 + bonus

**About Bask & Lather**

Bask & Lather is a rapidly growing beauty and haircare company dedicated to helping consumers achieve healthier hair and feel confident in their natural beauty. Rooted in a scalp-first philosophy, product efficacy and authentic storytelling, we serve customers across DTC, Amazon, TikTok Shop and national retail. Our mission is to help customers grow it and keep it too.

**About the Role**

We are seeking a Director of Creative Performance to lead our paid acquisition creative function. You will turn customer insights and performance data into compelling ads, build a disciplined testing and learning process, and develop a reliable pipeline of creative that can sustain profitable spend.

Reporting to the Head of Growth, you will own creative strategy, briefs, production coordination, quality assurance, and creative performance analysis. This is a hands-on leadership role requiring analytical depth, creative judgment, and strong execution.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Creative strategy and testing:** Build a prioritized roadmap for Meta, TikTok, YouTube, and other active acquisition channels. Define customer audiences, objections, product benefits, hooks, formats, and hypotheses for each test.
* **Production and delivery:** Translate strategy into clear briefs, scripts, demonstrations, and channel-specific assets. Manage the production calendar, feedback, approvals, and delivery against agreed deadlines.
* **Creative learning and iteration:** Review results with Growth, identify why concepts perform, and turn findings into the next briefs. Expand winning concepts and diagnose weaker executions before deciding whether to revise or retire them.
* **Creators and partners:** Manage performance creative agencies, UGC partners, freelancers, and production vendors. Improve quality, turnaround time, and cost efficiency while building dependable production capacity.
* **Team and resources:** Lead assigned creative resources, establish clear ownership, and manage approved production budgets. Recommend staffing, partner, and capacity changes to the Head of Growth.

**Cross Functional Collaboration**

You will own the paid acquisition creative roadmap and production priorities within approved resources. Growth owns media budgets, campaign execution, and spend allocation; you will jointly define testing conditions, evaluate results, and recommend which concepts merit additional investment.

Partner with Brand and Design to uphold brand standards, and with Product Development and the appropriate reviewers to ensure product education and claims are accurate. Coordinate with Integrated Marketing, Ecommerce, and Retention around launches, offers, customer insights, and reusable assets. Organic social, brand campaigns, and lifecycle creative are partner functions with separately agreed priorities.

**Creative Operations and Accountability**

* Maintain a searchable asset library with consistent naming, concept tagging, performance history, usage rights, and approval records.
* Plan production capacity against the testing roadmap and budget. Flag delivery risks early, resolve bottlenecks, and maintain backup partners for critical needs.
* Establish a consistent review process for product accuracy, demonstrations, brand alignment, platform specifications, and creator permissions before launch.
* Use AI and workflow automation where they improve research, ideation, briefing, reporting, or production efficiency, with human review for accuracy and quality.
* Run a weekly creative review covering results, lessons, fatigue, production status, budget, next tests, owners, and deadlines. Bring recommendations supported by evidence and clear hypotheses.

**How Success Will Be Measured**

During onboarding, you and the Head of Growth will establish baselines, consistent metric definitions, and numerical targets. The scorecard will track:

* **Creative effectiveness:** The share of original concepts that meet agreed acquisition or profitability targets at a defined spend threshold, the spend sustained by winners, and their useful lifespan.
* **Testing and learning:** Original concepts tested, meaningful hypotheses validated, and the speed at which learning becomes new creative. Track original concepts separately from asset variations.
* **Operating performance:** Brief-to-launch time, on-time delivery, cost per tested concept, budget adherence, and production capacity against the approved roadmap.
* **Diagnostic metrics:** Channel-appropriate hook and hold rates, CTR, conversion, CPA, ROAS, and fatigue indicators. Interpret these in the context of spend, audience, placement, attribution, and offer.

Acquisition and profitability outcomes are shared with Growth. Creative output volume alone will not define success.

**Required Experience and Capabilities**

* 8+ years of relevant experience in performance creative, creative strategy, or growth marketing, including leadership of creative teams or external production partners.
* A demonstrated record of developing ads that supported profitable acquisition for a consumer product brand. Beauty, personal care, or wellness experience is strongly preferred.
* Deep working knowledge of Meta and TikTok creative, with experience adapting concepts for YouTube and other acquisition channels.
* Strong analytical judgment and the ability to distinguish a creative insight from an attribution, media, audience, or offer issue.
* Hands-on skill in briefing, scripting, product demonstrations, UGC, editing feedback, and translating customer objections into effective creative.
* Experience managing production budgets, agencies, creators, timelines, and competing priorities. You set clear expectations, surface risks early, and follow through.

**Portfolio and Results Standard**

Be prepared to walk through examples showing the original hypothesis, your contribution, testing approach, spend supported, performance results, and subsequent iterations. We want to understand what you built, how you measured it, and what you learned. Share team and budget scope where possible, using anonymized information when needed.

**Compensation and Benefits**

Base salary of $170,000–$190,000, plus annual performance bonus tied to agreed role and organizational goals. Comprehensive benefits and paid time off.

**Equal Employment Opportunity**

Bask & Lather is an equal opportunity employer. We make employment decisions based on qualifications, merit, and business needs, without regard to race, color, religion, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, military or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. We provide reasonable accommodations to qualified applicants and employees with disabilities and for other legally protected needs. Applicants who need an accommodation during the hiring process may request assistance from our recruiting team.

title: Director of Creative (Remote US)
description:
**Directive Consulting** is the leading B2B marketing agency for companies that are done optimizing for metrics that don't move the business. With over a decade of expertise and 420+ B2B brands behind us, we know what real results look like. We operate through 3 divisions: **Performance, Communications, and Commerce,** each built to share intelligence and align on revenue. Our methodology, **DiscoverabilityOS**, aligns brand and demand to guide your ICP to choose you across every decision point. Across Technology, Industrial, and Services verticals, that system spans everything from Paid Media and **Content** Marketing to PR and Paid Social to Marketplace and Lifecycle Marketing.

At Directive, we're always looking to connect with talented people who care about work that actually counts. As we grow across all 3 divisions, we're seeking forward-thinking people who thrive in fast-paced environments, are obsessed with analytics and storytelling, and are ready to make their mark doing B2B marketing that actually means something.

**THE ROLE**

We're looking for a Director of Creative to lead our Performance Design department — a team that sits at the intersection of creative craft and performance marketing. This is not a traditional Director of Creative role. In this role, you will often wear two different “hats”. You'll be equally responsible for the strategic & financial direction of the department and the day-to-day development of the people and work within it. You'll inherit a team with strong momentum, an established methodology, and a clear positioning — and your job is to scale it.

This role reports to senior leadership and manages the full Performance Design team, including designers, project management, and motion contractors.

**Creative Leadership & Output**

* Own the creative vision and quality standard for the Performance Design department
* Ensure all work meets both craft and conversion benchmarks — great looking and built to perform
* Review and elevate creative across paid social, display, video, and landing page formats
* Build systems and workflows that help support excellent creative output for our clients both internally and externally.
* Ensure we’re running campaigns vs. ads
* Ensure we are testing & learning
* Partner with Directive senior leadership to develop our unique and ownable creative process that supports DiscoverabilityOS

**People Management & Team Development**

* Lead, coach, and develop a multidisciplinary team of designers and motion contractors
* Set clear expectations, foster accountability, and build a culture where creative people do their best work
* Identify growth opportunities for team members and actively invest in their development

**Strategy & Client Partnership**

* Partner closely with paid media and client success teams to ensure the creative is data-informed from the start
* Represent the department in new business pitches, cross-sell opportunities, and client conversations. While you will not be client-facing from a day-to-day perspective with our clients, you will be expected to meet with them monthly during leadership meetings to discuss quality & results.
* Articulate the value of Performance Design as a strategic capability, not just an execution function.

**Financial Ownership**

* Own and manage the department P&L - helping to make all budgeting decisions around staffing, tech investments, and other investments for the department.
* Monitor margins, manage resourcing decisions with financial impact in mind, and ensure the department operates as a profitable, scalable business unit with monthly revenue targets and direct margin goals.

**AI & Technology Integration**

* Lead adoption of AI creative tools across the team
* Identify where emerging technologies can sharpen output and improve efficiency
* Build AI into real production workflows — not just as a proof of concept

**WHAT YOU OFFER**

**Experience & Background**

* 5+ years in creative roles within performance marketing, paid media, or growth-focused agency environments
* Proven track record in managing creative teams and balancing creative quality with business outcomes
* Comfortable presenting department strategy and financial projections to VPs and CMOs, just as much as reviewing a creative brief

**Business Acumen**

* Strong understanding of how a creative department operates as a business
* Direct experience managing or having visibility into P&L, margin, and resourcing decisions
* You think like an owner and make decisions with financial impact in mind

**AI & Tools**

* Hands-on experience with AI creative tools — generative image, AI-powered video, design analytics, or similar
* Knows how to integrate AI into real production workflows, not just demo it
* Experience with platforms like EyeQuant, Creatify, or Superside is a plus

**Communication & Stakeholder Management**

* Strong communicator with executive presence who can translate creative thinking into business language
* Track record of building trust with both creative practitioners and senior leadership

**What Success Looks Like:**

In the first 90 days, you've built strong relationships across the team and key internal stakeholders, identified gaps in methodology and workflow, and begun making your mark on the department's output.

Within six months, you're running the department with full confidence — driving creative quality, owning margin targets, making smart resourcing decisions, and positioning Performance Design as a competitive differentiator in new business conversations.

**WHAT WE OFFER**

* We have a set living wage at Directive; The annual base salary range for this position based in the US is $160,000-$185,000 USD. This salary range is an estimate, and the actual salary may vary based on Directive's compensation practices, job related skills, and depth of experience.
* Medical, dental, vision plans, disability, and life insurance coverage for you and your family that fit your lifestyle

  + Including a 100% employer-paid plan for you and a 50% employer contribution for your dependents
* Benefits to Support the Whole Person:

  + Mental - Access to certified therapists through Spring Health, membership to Headspace
  + Physical - Physical therapy through Omada, fertility support through Carrott, thousands of Aaptiv virtual workouts, complimentary One Medical membership for primary and virtual care
  + Time Off - Unlimited PTO (2-week minimum), Paid Company Holidays, Your Birthday Off, End of Year Recharge (Closed December 24 - January 1), Paid Parental Leave
  + Financial - Traditional and Roth 401(k) with a 3% company match
  + Bonus - Annual bonus based on tenure, which scales in total amount over time

**WORK ENVIRONMENT**

Directive is a remote-first company. This role operates 100% virtually from your home office. We collaborate through Zoom and Slack. You will need a reliable setup, high-speed internet, and a professional working environment capable of running Adobe Creative Suite and video production software without interruption.

We accommodate global candidates in markets where Directive has established business operations, including Canada, Mexico, and the UK. Current, permanent work authorization in that country is required. Due to the nature of this role, you must be able to remain stationary for extended periods, operate design and video software on Mac or PC, and observe and interpret written and verbal communication consistently. Reasonable accommodations are available for qualified individuals with disabilities — contact recruiting@directiveconsulting.com.

**ADDITIONAL INFORMATION**

At Directive, one of our core values is People First. We are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive culture in the digital landscape. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status.

If you require reasonable accommodations in completing this application, interviewing, completing any pre-employment testing, or otherwise participating in the employee selection process, please direct your inquiries to recruiting@directiveconsulting.com.

title: Director of Design Execution
description:
### **About Switch**

At Switch, we don't just design, build and operate data centers—we are enabling the technology of the future. Led by Founder & CEO, Rob Roy, we believe in revolutionary innovation, operational excellence and the principle of karma. Switch is where talented people come together to EVOLVE the digital world.

We believe that innovation isn't just about technology—it's about the people, culture, and purpose that make it happen. Every Switch team member contributes to a mission greater than themselves: to create the world's most advanced digital infrastructure that powers the progress of humanity.

**The Role: Director of Design Execution**
------------------------------------------

The Director of Design Execution provides enterprise leadership for the practical execution, technical coordination, and field validation of data center designs across Switch's project portfolio. This role leads the team responsible for translating design intent into solutions that are safe, constructible, commissionable, operable, maintainable, and repeatable.

You will lead Design Execution from post-design handoff through construction, commissioning, turnover, and operational readiness while providing technical support throughout the infrastructure lifecycle. You will establish engineering governance, execution standards, decision and escalation processes, and feedback mechanisms that improve reliability and consistency across regions.

This role leads a team of technical subject matter experts and manages supporting third-party consultants and contractors. You will also partner closely with Design Engineering, Construction, Commissioning, Operations, EHS, Finance, Legal, and other stakeholders to improve project delivery and turn field experience into standards and lessons learned for future projects.

**What You'll Do**
------------------

* Lead and develop the Design Execution team, including technical subject matter experts and supporting third-party consultants and contractors.
* Set team priorities, allocate resources, establish performance expectations, and provide coaching and development.
* Lead Design Execution activities across the project lifecycle, including design handoff, construction, commissioning, turnover, operations support, infrastructure improvements, and end-of-life planning.
* Establish and maintain the engineering governance framework for post-IFC execution, including handoff requirements, engineering decision management, escalation pathways, design-change oversight, performance metrics, and continuous improvement.
* Translate design intent into practical field execution requirements that support constructability, commissioning, maintainability, and operational readiness.
* Oversee resolution of construction and field engineering issues, including complex procedure reviews, critical equipment concerns, and technical event support.
* Oversee engineering solutions for upgrades and retrofits that increase capacity, availability, efficiency, reliability, or operational capability across existing data centers.
* Provide technical leadership for electrical and mechanical infrastructure, including transformers, generators, UPS systems, power distribution, HVAC and cooling systems, controls, and related critical infrastructure.
* Review and interpret construction drawings, wiring diagrams, schematics, sequences of operation, specifications, submittals, and other engineering documentation.
* Partner with Design Engineering to translate field experience, operational feedback, commissioning results, and lessons learned into improved standards and future designs.
* Coordinate with Construction, Commissioning, Operations, EHS, and other stakeholders to maintain consistent technical and execution standards across projects.
* Manage engineering consultants, vendors, contractors, and other external technical resources supporting Design Execution.
* Establish processes, procedures, and tools that enable consistent execution and support customer and project requirements across data center campuses.
* Establish and monitor Design Execution performance metrics and provide project, risk, and program updates to senior leadership.
* Lead assigned engineering projects and programs and ensure delivery against schedule, budget, quality, and operational requirements.
* Coordinate maintenance windows and implementation activities with facility leadership to minimize operational disruption.
* Ensure Design Execution activities comply with applicable codes, regulations, Switch requirements, and safety standards, including NFPA 70E requirements where applicable.
* Support Operations during turnover, customer-impacting events, near misses, and other complex technical situations.
* Identify systemic issues, recurring field challenges, and opportunities to improve execution, reliability, efficiency, and cost.
* Build strong working relationships across Operations, Finance, Legal, Construction, Commissioning, Design Engineering, and other stakeholders.
* Maintain an active field presence to understand conditions firsthand and validate that solutions can be executed as intended.

**What We're Looking For**
--------------------------

* You lead technical teams with clear expectations, accountability, coaching, and consistent follow-through.
* You make sound engineering decisions while balancing safety, reliability, constructability, cost, schedule, and operational impact.
* You can make informed recommendations when technical information is incomplete or conditions are changing.
* You identify design and execution risks early and develop practical solutions before they affect project or operational outcomes.
* You communicate complex engineering issues clearly to technical teams, business partners, and senior leadership.
* You build alignment across Design Engineering, Construction, Commissioning, Operations, and external partners.
* You establish standards and governance that improve consistency without creating unnecessary barriers to execution.
* You use field experience, data, root cause analysis, and lessons learned to drive continuous improvement.
* You develop internal talent while holding consultants, contractors, and other external resources accountable for quality and results.
* You are comfortable spending time in the field to understand problems firsthand and validate solutions.
* You demonstrate the judgment, accountability, collaboration, and leadership expected under Switch's Culture Codes.

**What You'll Bring**
---------------------

**Required Qualifications**

* 10+ years of progressive engineering experience supporting industrial, commercial, or mission-critical facilities such as data centers, power generation, or oil and gas facilities.
* 5+ years of experience leading engineering teams, technical professionals, consultants, or comparable resources.
* 4+ years of project management experience supporting data center engineering or comparable mission-critical infrastructure.
* Deep understanding of electrical and mechanical systems used in mission-critical environments, including power distribution, transformers, generators, switchgear, UPS systems, cooling systems, HVAC, controls, and fire protection.
* Experience leading or supporting construction, commissioning, turnover, operational readiness, retrofit, or infrastructure improvement activities.
* Experience managing engineering projects, consultants, contractors, and other external technical resources.
* Experience reading, interpreting, and reviewing construction drawings, specifications, submittals, wiring diagrams, schematics, sequences of operation, and MEP documentation.
* Experience with EPMS, SCADA, BMS, or comparable monitoring and controls systems.
* Strong knowledge of safety requirements and applicable OSHA standards for multi-megawatt or mission-critical facilities.
* Working knowledge of NFPA 70E and electrical safety requirements.
* Demonstrated ability to develop and execute solutions for complex engineering and operational problems.
* Strong project and program management, prioritization, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
* Strong written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills.
* Experience using engineering, project management, calculation, data analysis, and collaboration tools.
* Ability to support after-hours or weekend activities when required for critical projects, maintenance windows, commissioning, or operational events.
* Ability to travel domestically and internationally as business needs require.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related field.
* Professional Engineer registration or other relevant professional engineering certification.
* Experience leading enterprise or multi-region engineering programs within data centers or other mission-critical environments.
* Experience establishing engineering governance, technical standards, design-change processes, or post-IFC execution frameworks.
* Experience supporting root cause analysis, fleet optimization, lifecycle management, and infrastructure reliability programs.

We recognize that qualified candidates may not meet every preferred qualification. If your experience aligns with the core responsibilities of the role, we encourage you to apply.

### **Why Switch?**

* A Culture of Karma – We are self-motivated by karma, ensuring our actions contribute to a positive, supportive and forward-thinking environment.
* Industry Leading Designs – Work with the most advanced data center technology on the planet and be a part of emerging technology development.
* Flexibility & Remote Opportunities – Whether in-office, hybrid, or fully remote, we offer the technology and support to keep teams connected and productive.
* Career Stability & Growth – In this expanding industry, we invest in our people, providing opportunities & advancement in a stable, growing company.

### **Join Us & Make a Difference**

This is more than a job—it's a mission. If you're ready to be part of a culture that values innovation, karma, and limitless potential, we want to hear from you.

Apply Now and Let's Build the Future Together.
