title: Director of Product Design
description:
Beacon Biosignals is transforming precision medicine for the brain, from clinical development to clinical care. For Life Sciences partners, we offer the leading at-home EEG platform for clinical development of novel therapeutics for neurological, psychiatric, and sleep disorders. Our Diagnostics business is building the most comprehensive at-home platform for precision diagnostics, combining EEG and cardiopulmonary signals to deliver reimbursable assessments for sleep and central nervous system disorders. Together, we're changing the way patients are diagnosed and treated for any disorder that affects brain physiology.

Beacon Biosignals is seeking a Director of Product Design to lead and grow our Product Design function. Product Design at Beacon is a shared function that serves the entire business: the hardware experience of our EEG headbands and other devices, the mobile apps that participants and patients use at home, the web applications that clinical teams and trial sponsors rely on, the printed materials that guide patients and site staff, and the design of internal business processes across logistics, support, and clinical operations. In this role you'll lead a team of three senior product designers, set the vision for how design works at Beacon, and plan the function's growth as the company scales. We expect this role to stay close to the craft. You'll model best practices directly alongside the team, not just direct it from above. This role reports directly to Beacon's VP of Platform.

Beacon's robust asynchronous work practices ensure a first-class remote work experience, but we also have in-person office hubs located in Boston, New York City, and Paris. For this position, candidates based in the Boston or surrounding area are preferred

**What success looks like:**

As a successful Director of Product Design at Beacon, you'll...

* Lead and coach a team of three senior product designers, helping each of them grow their craft, expand their impact, and build a clear path forward in their careers.
* Craft, iterate, and execute on a vision for what product design should be at Beacon, and translate that vision into a concrete plan for how the function grows alongside the business.
* Operate as a player-coach, particularly in your first year: taking on design work yourself where it sets the standard, demonstrating the practices you want to see, and raising the bar by example rather than by directive.
* Own prioritization across the full breadth of Beacon's design surface, from device and mobile to web, print, and business process, making the tradeoffs that determine where a small, senior team spends its time and ensuring no single designer becomes a bottleneck for the company.
* Build the cross-functional connections that design depends on, partnering closely with Device Engineering, Platform, Clinical Operations, Logistics, Support, and Quality to bring design into decisions early rather than at the end.
* Establish the processes, standards, and shared systems that let design scale: a coherent design language across hardware and software, reusable patterns, and design reviews that improve quality without slowing delivery.
* Ensure design's contribution to Beacon's regulated products is rigorous and well-documented, partnering with Quality and Regulatory on usability and human factors work for our cleared devices.
* Own the headcount plan, budget, and vendor relationships for the function, and make the case for investment in design with the same rigor you'd bring to a design problem.
* Develop a deep understanding of everyone Beacon serves: patients using our devices unsupervised at home, the clinical staff and healthcare providers who care for them, the site teams running trials, and the sponsors who rely on the insights we deliver. Build the research practice that keeps that understanding current.
* Develop an equally deep understanding of how Beacon itself operates, so that design serves our internal teams as well as our external users, from device provisioning and logistics through support and scientific services.
* See around corners: anticipate where design debt, inconsistency, or unowned experience problems are accumulating, and address them before they become urgent.

**What you will bring:**

* 10+ years of product design experience, including 4+ years managing and developing designers.
* Experience building or substantially maturing a design function. You know what the first eighteen months of that work actually look like.
* A portfolio that spans both hardware and software experiences. You're comfortable moving between a physical device, a mobile app, a data-heavy web application, and the printed material that ties them together.
* You have experience and familiarity working in the medical device space, clinical diagnostics, real-world-data, pharma/biotech or other related fields.
* You've worked in a regulated industry before, and have successfully navigated the tension between fast-paced iterative design and strict design controls. Familiarity with usability engineering and human factors practice (e.g. IEC 62366, FDA human factors guidance) is a strong plus.
* You're genuinely energized by coaching senior individual contributors. You can give feedback that a strong, experienced designer will respect and act on.
* You're comfortable being hands-on without defaulting to it. You know the difference between modeling the work and doing the work because it's easier than delegating it.
* Experience designing service and business process experiences, not just product interfaces. You've improved how an organization operates, not only what it ships.
* You bring strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to align partners around decisions, tradeoffs, and evolving plans, including in regulated or quality-sensitive environments.
* You demonstrate a bias towards simplicity, avoid misallocating complexity, and try to impose structure at the right time - not too early or too late.
* You're comfortable working in a highly asynchronous remote work environment, and have demonstrated success doing so in the past.

The base salary range for this role is $200,000 - $215,000, depending on past experience, specific skills, and qualifications. The base salary is one component of the total compensation package, which includes equity, PTO, and other benefits.

At Beacon, we've found that cultural and scientific impact is driven most by those that lead by example. As such, we're always seeking new contributors whose work demonstrates an avid curiosity, a bias towards simplicity, an eye for composability, a self-service mindset, and - most of all - a deep empathy towards colleagues, stakeholders, users, and patients. We believe a diverse team builds more robust systems and achieves higher impact.

title: 21GRAMS- Director, Product Design (UI)

At Real Chemistry, making the world a healthier place isn’t just an aspiration—it’s our everyday reality. Whether you're a seasoned professional or just starting your career, if you share our passion for healthcare and connection, we invite you to explore our opportunities.

Discover your purpose. Embrace innovation. Experience #LifeatRealChem.

**21GRAMS, a Real Chemistry subsidiary, is an advertising agency born to make healthcare more human.** Not just in our work, but in how we conduct business, approach client relationships, and treat each other. We believe in being good to each other and hard on the work, and in creating work that makes a meaningful difference for patients, caregivers, healthcare professionals, and brands.

#### **Job Summary**

The Director, Product Design is a senior design leader responsible for setting the product design vision, raising the quality of the work, and building the conditions for teams to deliver cohesive, accessible, and effective digital experiences. This role leads complex engagements across websites, platforms, products, services, and connected ecosystems, translating user needs, brand strategy, business goals, technology constraints, and healthcare requirements into clear experience direction.

This is not solely an execution role. The Director is accountable for design strategy, client leadership, team development, resourcing, design operations, and measurable experience outcomes. They remain close enough to the work to guide critical decisions, facilitate discovery, critique design, and step into high-impact moments while enabling senior designers to lead day to day.

#### **What You Will Do**

**Design Vision and Product Strategy**

* Own the product design vision and experience strategy across a portfolio of complex client engagements, connecting user needs, brand intent, business objectives, and technical feasibility.
* Partner with Experience Strategy, UX, Product Management, Creative, Technology, Data, Medical, Strategy, and Account leadership to frame opportunities, define roadmaps, and establish measurable outcomes.
* Lead discovery and definition activities, including stakeholder alignment, experience principles, journey framing, service blueprints, value propositions, prioritization, and product or platform planning.
* Identify opportunities that extend beyond the immediate brief and turn them into clear, decision-ready recommendations for clients and agency leadership.

**Design Excellence and Delivery**

* Set and uphold a high bar for interaction design, visual design, responsive behavior, content hierarchy, prototyping, motion, and end-to-end experience coherence.
* Guide teams from early concepts through detailed design, validation, launch, and optimization, ensuring that strategic intent is maintained through implementation.
* Oversee scalable design systems, component libraries, pattern governance, and documentation in Figma, working with engineering partners to improve quality and delivery efficiency.
* Build accessibility into the work from the start, applying WCAG 2.2 AA principles and inclusive design practices rather than treating compliance as a final review step.
* Use qualitative research, analytics, usability findings, and business measures to evaluate design decisions and recommend iteration.

**Client and Cross-Functional Leadership**

* Act as a trusted senior design partner to clients, clearly articulating experience strategy, design rationale, trade-offs, risks, and recommendations to executive and working teams.
* Lead high-stakes presentations, workshops, critiques, and decision-making sessions, creating alignment across internal and external stakeholders.
* Partner with project and account leadership on scope, staffing, schedules, assumptions, and change management; surface delivery risks early and propose practical solutions.
* Represent Product Design in new-business opportunities, estimates, proposals, capability presentations, and pitch work.

**People Leadership and Practice Development**

* Manage, coach, and develop product designers across levels through clear expectations, actionable feedback, growth plans, and regular career conversations.
* Create an environment where designers can do their best work, with strong critique, psychological safety, accountability, and thoughtful delegation.
* Partner with Experience leadership on hiring, staffing, performance management, succession planning, and capability development.
* Improve the Product Design practice through reusable methods, templates, standards, training, and responsible adoption of emerging tools, including AI-enabled workflows.
* Contribute to a culture of collaboration across Product Design, UX, Creative, Technology, and Strategy, reducing silos and improving continuity from concept through launch.

#### **What Success Looks Like**

* Clients see Product Design as a strategic partner, not only a production capability.
* Teams have clear experience direction, decision criteria, and an appropriate level of design leadership from discovery through delivery.
* Creates a more consistent, accessible, and high-quality experience across the portfolio.
* Designers receive strong coaching, understand what is expected of them, and demonstrate measurable growth.
* The practice becomes more scalable through better systems, methods, staffing decisions, and cross-functional ways of working.
* Experience recommendations connect to defined user, client, and business outcomes.

#### **What You Should Have**

* 10+ years of experience in product design, experience design, interaction design, or a related discipline, including 3+ years managing and developing designers.
* A portfolio demonstrating leadership across complex, multi-channel digital products or platforms, from strategy and concept through detailed design and launch.
* Experience leading multiple workstreams or a portfolio of client engagements in an agency, consultancy, product organization, or similarly complex environment.
* Deep fluency in human-centered design, interaction design, visual systems, prototyping, responsive design, information architecture, and design systems.
* Strong working knowledge of Figma and modern collaborative design workflows; familiarity with Adobe Creative Cloud and prototyping or motion tools is helpful.
* Practical knowledge of accessibility standards, including WCAG 2.2 AA, and the ability to guide teams in designing inclusive experiences.
* Demonstrated ability to partner with engineering, product, research, content, analytics, strategy, creative, and account teams.
* Excellent executive communication, facilitation, storytelling, critique, negotiation, and stakeholder-management skills.
* Experience defining design outcomes and using research, usability testing, analytics, and performance data to improve experiences.
* Comfort operating in ambiguity, making informed trade-offs, and balancing strategic leadership with hands-on guidance when the work requires it.

#### **This Position Is a Strong Fit If**

* You can move between the 30,000-foot view and the detail that determines whether an experience actually works.
* You are direct, low-ego, generous with feedback, and able to challenge the work while supporting the people doing it.
* You bring structure to ambiguity, anticipate needs, and help teams make better decisions faster.
* You care about craft, but judge success by the quality, usefulness, accessibility, and impact of the experience.
* Our Company values – *Best Together, Impact-Obsessed, Excellence Expected, Evolve Always* and *Accountability with an “I”* – really speak to you.
* You are adaptable, resilient, and OK with adjusting your scope, responsibilities, and focus as we grow. When things change, so do we. We’re always evolving.
* You are proactive, driven, and resourceful with strong prioritization skills and a desire to dive into the data.
* You are highly organized self-starter, able to work independently and under tight deadlines.

#### **Preferred Experience**

* Healthcare, pharmaceutical, patient support, medical technology, or other regulated-industry experience.
* Experience with privacy, consent, regulated content, and design considerations for patients, caregivers, and healthcare professionals.
* Experience supporting business development, scoping, estimating, and presenting capabilities or pitch work.
* Experience leading enterprise websites, authenticated platforms, service ecosystems, omnichannel programs, or AI-enabled experiences.

  

**Pay Range:** $140,000 - $155,000  
This is the pay range the Company believes it will pay for this position at the time of this posting. Consistent with applicable law, compensation will be determined based on job-related, non-discriminatory factors including but not limited to work experience, skills, certifications, and geographical location. The Company reserves the right to modify this pay range at any time.

title: Director, Dealers and Design - South
description:
**Job Description:**

The Director, Dealers and Design is responsible for leading and partnering with our field team to develop and grow our Residential, Dealer Segment, and Residential A&D Channel business within the **South region.**

The leader in this role will work collaboratively to develop territory plans and sales strategies, while working independently and in team-selling scenarios to pursue business development opportunities, lead complex sales pursuits, and manage key accounts.

**Roles & Responsibilities:**

**Strategic Sales Development & Execution**

* Develop and execute strategic account and territory plans focused on key accounts, residential design firms, and business development opportunities where Cambria has limited penetration or significant growth opportunity.
* Establish and define a list of strong existing dealers and A&D in your territory that you will ensure stay up to date and grow their mind share and wallet share.
* Identify, pursue, and win net-new business with national accounts, buying groups, specialty markets, and high-value targets within each dealer segment business channel.
* Establish executive and senior-level relationships with top-level decision-makers, purchasing managers, and key influencers across the residential ecosystem.
* Represent Cambria at local, regional, and national trade shows and industry events.

**Field Leadership, Coaching & Mentoring**

* Drive Cambria sales by training, coaching, and mentoring Market Representatives, Showroom/Gallery Managers, and District Managers in a defined region.
* Coach, develop, and mentor field sales teams on best practices for approaching and working within the residential segment by modeling successful use of tools, playbooks, resources, and strategies.
* Provide ongoing training, support, and education to guide field sales teams in their approach to residential business development within the Dealer Segment and Residential A&D Channels.

**Cross-Functional Collaboration & Field Engagement**

* Partner closely with the Regional Vice President, District Managers, and Market Representatives within the assigned region to align on the development and execution of territory plans and growth initiatives.
* Travel frequently with Market Representatives, District Managers, and Cambria’s SDC Showrooms and Galleries to educate and mentor team members on segment best practices.

**Qualifications & Skills:**

* Proven track record in building material sales and the interior design industry, with strong customer-focused sales skills and the ability to track and close business.
* Demonstrated experience in B2B sales, specification, or design-focused sales channels.
* Exceptional interpersonal, verbal, and written communication skills to build strong professional relationships, inspire teams, and gain internal and external support.
* Strong critical thinking, organizational, and calendar management skills, backed by disciplined CRM tracking and timely follow-up.
* Entrepreneurial mindset with the ability to work independently from a home office while effectively managing travel across an assigned territory.
* High degree of professionalism, integrity, and fiscal responsibility.

**Minimum Requirements:**

**Education:** Bachelor’s degree preferred.

**Experience:** 5+ years of industry sales experience required.

**Systems:** Google Workspace, Microsoft Office Suite, and Salesforce proficiency required.

**Additional Requirements:**

**Travel Requirements:** This position will require up to 70% travel within the region for events, meetings, trade shows, and Field Sales training. The candidate must be able to work extended hours, evenings, overnights, and weekends. This role does not require a company vehicle.

* Must hold a valid Driver’s License.
* Must be able to successfully pass a Motor Vehicle Record (MVR) check in accordance with Cambria's standards.

**Physical Requirements:** The candidate must be able to lift up to 50 pounds, set up and tear down marketing materials, and meet requirements to attend in-person meetings.

Cambria’s starting salary range for this position is $110,438 - $154,453. Salary ranges are determined by role, level, and location. The range displayed on each job posting reflects the target for new hires for the position. Individual pay is determined by several factors, including work location, job-related experience, and relevant education and/or training.

Cambria offers a competitive benefits package that encompasses Health and Dental Insurance, Paid Time Off, 7 paid Holidays , 401(k) plus matching, Discretionary Profit Sharing, Flexible Spending Account; Life, Supplemental Life, and Disability Insurance; Referral Program, Tuition Reimbursement, Employee Assistance Program, Employee Discount and Professional Development Assistance.

title: Community Manager
description:
Kickstarter is the leading crowdfunding platform for creative projects across film, games, music, art, design, and technology. Since our founding in 2009, our mission to help bring creative projects to life has been powered by the people behind the work.

Together, we’ve helped creators around the world launch creative projects that have generated billions of dollars in pledges. That same commitment extends inward. Rooted in shared values, Kickstarter invests in the growth and success of our team, treating employees as whole people and empowering them with the autonomy and space to participate in decisions that shape their work and our company.

Kickstarter is seeking an experienced Community Manager to join our Marketing team. This role sits at the heart of how Kickstarter shows up and is perceived across the places our community talks: social, Reddit, Discord, review sites, forums, and the corners of the internet where creators and backers compare notes. Reporting to the Director, Brand and Communications, the Community Manager will listen, respond, and engage, and will work closely with cross-functional teams to route what they hear to the people who can act on it.

As the owner of Kickstarter’s community presence and reputation, they serve as our early-warning system when sentiment shifts or a problem starts to spread. This is not a “schedule posts and check metrics” role. The ideal candidate is already deep in these communities, knows the norms of each one, and gets a little twitchy when a thread starts to turn.

The salary for this role in the United States is $115,905.50.

#### **In This Role, You Will:**

*Reputation Management and Monitoring*

* Monitor brand mentions, sentiment, and emerging narratives across social, Reddit, Discord, review sites, forums, and the broader web, in real time.
* Spot early signals of reputational risk (a viral complaint, a controversial project, a misunderstanding of our policies), assess severity, and lead the response, partnering with Communications, Trust & Safety, Legal, and leadership on sensitive or high-stakes moments.
* Design and own the escalation framework with Communications, Trust & Safety, Support, Product, Legal, and leadership, including severity tiers, owners, and response timelines.
* Build, own, and continuously refine response playbooks for common scenarios (project controversies, creator disputes, outages, policy changes, and press-driven moments), and run post-incident reviews to improve them.
* Define how we measure community sentiment and reputation, and deliver regular reporting to senior stakeholders that connects trends to business and mission impact, with clear recommendations.

*Community Engagement*

* Show up as Kickstarter in public conversations, in a voice that is human, direct, and well-informed.
* Participate credibly in Reddit and Discord communities, following each community’s rules and culture rather than treating them as broadcast channels.
* Correct misinformation helpfully, de-escalate heated threads, and know when not to respond.
* Support creators and backers by pointing them to the right resources, and handing off to Support when an issue needs a ticket.
* Celebrate creator milestones and engage with backers and make Kickstarter feel present and human beyond our owned social channels.
* Set voice, tone, and engagement guidelines for Kickstarter’s presence in community spaces, and coach teammates who engage on the company’s behalf.

*Feedback Loop*

* Own a community feedback program that turns unstructured community input into prioritized, evidence-backed insights for Product, Design, Policy, Support, and Creator Success, and track what gets acted on.
* Maintain a living picture of the top recurring pain points, feature requests, and trust issues, with examples.
* Close the loop publicly when we ship something the community asked for.
* Build and run a creator and backer advocacy program, identifying enthusiastic community members for testimonials, campaigns, and storytelling.

*Programs and Operations*

* Own the strategy and operation of Kickstarter-owned community spaces (e.g., Discord, creator forums), including moderation guidelines, tooling, and volunteer or mod programs.
* Align Social, Comms, and our creator-facing teams on campaigns, launches, and announcements so community context is built in from the start.
* Select, manage, and optimize our social listening and community tooling, including vendor evaluation and measurement.
* Track emerging creator communities, cultural trends, competitor conversations, new platforms and community behaviors.
* Translate community insights into recommendations that inform marketing, acquisition, and product priorities.

#### **About You**

* You have 4+ years in community management, social media, reputation management, or a related role, ideally at a platform, marketplace, or consumer tech company.
* You have deep, demonstrable fluency in Reddit and Discord, as a longtime participant and not just a brand account. You know what a good community looks like and what gets a brand banned or mocked.
* You have hands-on experience across the major social platforms (X, Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, YouTube, LinkedIn, Bluesky, Threads), including how norms and audiences differ on each.
* You have experience monitoring and managing sentiment on review and feedback sites (e.g., Trustpilot, App Store and Google Play reviews, Hacker News, and niche forums).
* You have strong judgment under pressure and ambiguity: you can tell a vocal minority from a real problem and a mistake from a crisis, and you make clear recommendations or calls without waiting to be told what to do.
* You are an excellent writer. You can be warm, plain-spoken, and precise, and you can adapt tone to the platform and the moment.
* You have experience with social listening and community tools (e.g., Sprout Social, Brandwatch, Sprinklr, Meltwater, Mention, or similar).
* You have experience building processes and aligning cross-functional partners, and you communicate clearly and credibly with executives, Legal, and Trust & Safety when stakes are high.
* You have a track record of owning a community, reputation, or voice-of-customer program end to end, with measurable results.
* You are familiar with crowdfunding, creator economy, or maker communities (games, comics, film, music, design, publishing, tech).
* You are familiar with platform-specific communities like BoardGameGeek, Product Hunt, Indie Hackers, or creator-focused Discords.
* You have experience handling public-facing communications during controversies or policy changes.
* You have data skills: you are comfortable building dashboards or pulling insights from large volumes of unstructured text.

**Our Fully Virtual Team**

We’re currently able to support employees based in the following US locations: CA, CO, CT, GA, IL, MA, MD, NC, NJ, NY, OR, SC, VA, VT, and WA. We're also able to support employees in the United Kingdom. If you live in—or are willing to move to—any of these locations, we look forward to your application! If there is a required or preferred location for an open role, it will be listed in the job description.

Kickstarter is an equal opportunity employer. As part of our commitment to fight for equality, we work to ensure a fair and consistent interview process. We celebrate diversity, and we are committed to an inclusive work environment.

Reminder to applicants: Authentic communications from Kickstarter will always originate from official Kickstarter email domains (@kickstarter.com). Exercise caution and verify the legitimacy of anyone who claims to be representing Kickstarter on other platforms.

Please reach out to Kickstarter’s Help Center to report potentially fraudulent contact here: https://help.kickstarter.com/hc/en-us/requests/new

title: Senior Content Manager
description:
**About the team**
------------------

Studio Z, Zillow's in-house creative agency, is seeking a senior editor to lead our Content team's work in search and AI-powered discovery. We develop engaging content that helps consumers and real estate professionals achieve their goals — from in-depth articles to snappy email copy to video scripts and social posts. We embody the Zillow core values of transparency, integrity, and putting customers first. To thrive here, you'll also need a good dose of empathy and a sense of humor.

**About the role**
------------------

This role will plan, edit, and publish a large volume of consumer-facing educational articles that guide people through buying, selling, renting, and financing a home — and help Zillow show up as a trusted source in AI tools like ChatGPT and Google's AI Overviews, as well as in traditional organic search. You'll own the editorial calendar for this program, turning topic priorities into clear assignments, guiding a bench of contract writers, and making the final call on accuracy, clarity, and brand alignment. You'll also help shape how our team uses AI tools to research, draft, and fact-check at scale, while keeping an expert human touch on everything we publish. Your rigorous, thoughtful editing will make Zillow the most helpful and trustworthy voice on people's most complex housing questions.

  

This is a full-time, remote, individual contributor role based in the US, reporting to the director of Studio Z Content.

  

**You'll get to:**
------------------

* Own a high-volume editorial program — hundreds of articles a year on financing, home buying, renting, local markets, and more — from planning through publishing.
* Build and manage an editorial calendar that balances business priorities, search and AI visibility opportunities, and content freshness.
* Assign, edit, and guide the work of staff and contract writers, giving clear, constructive feedback that raises quality and consistency across the program.
* Partner with Zillow's Traffic and SEO team to turn search and AI visibility insights into topics, outlines, and optimizations — and track how the content performs.
* Work with Zillow’s Economic Research team to craft insightful, accessible, and accurate guides to housing market data and trends using Zillow tools.
* Shepherd content through expert, legal, and compliance reviews, especially on mortgage and financing topics, keeping work accurate and on schedule.
* Help pioneer AI-assisted workflows for outlining, drafting, and fact-checking, while ensuring every asset meets our standards for accuracy and brand voice.
* Build understanding and empathy for the challenges facing Americans who are looking to buy, sell, finance, and rent homes in a complex market.

This role has been categorized as a Remote position. “Remote” employees do not have a permanent corporate office workplace and, instead, work from a physical location of their choice, which must be identified to the Company. U.S. employees may live in any of the 50 United States, with limited exceptions.In California, Connecticut, Maryland, Massachusetts, New Jersey, New York, Washington state, and Washington DC the standard base pay range for this role is $112,800.00 - $180,200.00 annually. This base pay range is specific to these locations and may not be applicable to other locations.

In Colorado, Hawaii, Illinois, Maine, Minnesota, Nevada, Ohio, Rhode Island, Vermont, and Virginia the standard base pay range for this role is $107,200.00 - $171,200.00 annually. The base pay range is specific to these locations and may not be applicable to other locations.In addition to a competitive base salary this position is also eligible for equity awards based on factors such as experience, performance and location. Actual amounts will vary depending on experience, performance and location. Employees in this role will not be paid below the salary threshold for exempt employees in the state where they reside.

**Who you are**
---------------

* A seasoned editor who has owned a content vertical on complex real estate and financing topics, and knows how to make detailed guidance clear, accurate, and actionable.
* A meticulous researcher and fact-checker who holds every claim to a high standard and can serve as the last set of eyes on a piece before it's published.
* An organized, decisive program owner who can run a large editorial calendar, juggle many stakeholders and deadlines, and make sound editorial calls independently.
* A search-savvy strategist who understands how SEO and generative engine optimization (GEO) shape content, and uses performance data to improve your work and communicate its value.
* A curious adopter of AI tools who sees them as a way to scale high-quality work, not replace it.
A kind, fun colleague who enjoys collaborating with other creatives and learning new things while making work we can all be proud of.  

  

**Qualifications:**
-------------------

* Minimum of 7 years of related experience, or equivalent work experience.
* Proven experience editing detailed consumer guidance on complex real estate and financing topics, including owning a content vertical that covers these subjects.
* Top-notch editorial skills, including writing, editing, research, fact-checking, and editorial calendar management.
* Deep experience finding and telling consumer-friendly stories using data. Familiarity with housing market data is a plus.
* Experience assigning and editing the work of freelance or contract writers.
* Experience creating and optimizing content for search. Familiarity with GEO and AI search visibility is a strong plus.
* Experience working within legal or compliance review processes in a regulated category, such as mortgage or financial services, is a plus.
* Ability to produce high-quality work efficiently and adapt quickly to shifting priorities.

**Get to know us**
------------------

At Zillow, we’re reimagining how people move—through the real estate market and through their careers. As the most-visited real estate platform in the U.S., we help people navigate buying, selling, financing and renting with greater ease and confidence. Whether you're working in tech, sales, operations, or design, you’ll be part of a company reshaping an industry and helping more people make home a reality.

  

How we work is a key part of that transformation. Through Cloud HQ, our strategic approach to distributed work, most employees have the flexibility to work from wherever they’re most productive—enabling us to move fast, stay connected and deliver on our people promise.

  

Zillow is honored to be recognized among the best workplaces in the U.S. Zillow was named one of FORTUNE 100 Best Companies to Work For® in 2026, and included on TIME’s America’s Best Companies 2026 list , reflecting our commitment to creating an innovative, inclusive, and engaging culture where employees are empowered to grow.

  

No matter where you sit in the organization, your work will help drive innovation, support our customers, and move the industry—and your career—forward, together.

  

*Zillow Group is an equal opportunity employer committed to fostering an inclusive, innovative environment with the best employees. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please contact your recruiter directly.*

  

*Qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with applicable state and local law.*

  

*Los Angeles County applicants: Job duties for this position include: work safely and cooperatively with other employees, supervisors, and staff; adhere to standards of excellence despite stressful conditions; communicate effectively and respectfully with employees, supervisors, and staff to ensure exceptional customer service; and follow all federal, state, and local laws and Company policies. Criminal history may have a direct, adverse, and negative relationship with some of the material job duties of this position. These include the duties and responsibilities listed above, as well as the abilities to adhere to company policies, exercise sound judgment, effectively manage stress and work safely and respectfully with others, exhibit trustworthiness and professionalism, and safeguard business operations and the Company’s reputation. Pursuant to the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.*

title: Senior Social Media Specialist, Culture & Insights
description:
**Summary**
-----------

Yelp’s mission is to connect people with great local businesses, and our social channels are a vital part of how we inspire discovery and build love for the brand. As the Social Media Specialist on the Consumer Growth Marketing team, you’ll be the person who knows what people are saying about Yelp, local businesses, and culture, and what Yelp should do about it. You’ll run social listening and community engagement, identify the cultural moments Yelp should tap into, own static asset production in close partnership with our video lead, and lead nuanced engagement on Reddit. This role calls for a high level of independence and judgment, and reports to the Associate Director of Social Media.

We’d love to have you apply, even if you don’t feel you meet every single requirement in this posting. At Yelp, we’re looking for great people, not just those who simply check off all the boxes. This is a full-time remote role based in the United States.

**What you'll do:**
-------------------

* Run day-to-day social listening across Yelp, competitors, the local business landscape, and wider culture in Brandwatch, including building and maintaining Boolean queries, topic tags, and alerts.
* Identify the cultural moments Yelp should tap into, from fashion weeks and award shows to viral trends and local events, and pitch the unexpected, useful angle that earns Yelp a place in the conversation.
* Move fast on those moments: shape the idea, build the asset, and get it approved and live while the moment is still happening.
* Turn signals into recommendations with a clear loop (what we’re seeing, why it matters, what we should do, who owns it); deliver recurring listening readouts and quick-turn analyses for launches and news cycles.
* Own proactive and reactive community engagement across Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, Reddit, Threads, X, and Facebook, writing replies that sound human, quick, and unmistakably Yelp.
* Lead nuanced engagement on Reddit: build a trusted presence in local food, city, and home services subreddits, handle critical and sensitive threads with care, and develop the playbook for when Yelp posts, replies, or stays out.
* Own static asset production from concept to publish, including reactive posts, carousels, static graphics, copy-led posts, and UGC features, using Canva and Figma.
* Partner closely with our video lead so that every insight and cultural moment lands in the right format, and plan the biggest moments together.
* Source, vet, and clear user-generated and review-based content for our channels.
* Manage the social editorial calendar in Wrike and Sprout Social, balancing planned campaigns with always-on and reactive content.
* Flag risks early and collaborate cross-functionally with Comms, PR, Support, Brand, Creative, and Product Marketing on escalations and campaigns.
* Report on content and community performance; deliver clear recommendations on what to repeat, change, scale, or stop.

**What it takes to succeed:**
-----------------------------

* 4+ years in social media for a consumer audience, with hands-on experience across social listening, community management, and content production.
* A strong read on culture: you know which moments are worth joining, which aren’t, and how a brand can show up in a way that feels earned. Include 2–3 examples of reactive or culture-led work with your role and results.

Brilliant is seeking a full-time **Associate Director, Client Management** for our Influencer & Celebrity team. This role will own the day-to-day client relationship and keep every influencer program on time, on budget, and flawlessly executed.

**The Role**
------------

This is a client-facing, project-management-first role. All day, every day, you are the voice of Brilliant to our clients: you run the calls, write the recap, chase the approvals, and make sure nothing slips. Our strategy and talent leads build the programs; you make sure they get delivered.

You are hyper-organized. You know where every creator, contract, deliverable, and invoice stands at any moment. You understand influencer budgets inside and out, and you have done this in high-volume agency settings where dozens of creators and multiple brands are live at once.

**Who We Are**
--------------

We’re a fully remote performance team built on a simple promise: *Work Hard. Play Hard. Laugh Hard.*

We aren't for the faint of heart. We move fast, hold a ridiculously high bar for excellence, and thrive on driving real ROI for our clients. But we also believe that intense drive should come with great culture, which is why we offer unlimited PTO, Fabulous Fridays (doors close at 3pm), virtual happy hours, a monthly book club, and endless reasons to win together.

And the industry notices: we were recently named an **Inc. Best Workplace 2026** and landed on the **Inc. 5000 List of America's Fastest-Growing Private Companies for 2026.**

**What We Do**
--------------

Since 2008, Brilliant has been where bold ideas meet relentless execution. We're a performance marketing agency with deep expertise in family-focused brands, bringing together PR, Influencer, Social, Paid Media, Affiliate, Retail Support, Experiential, and AI Intelligence to create integrated, full-funnel campaigns that shatter targets and cut through the noise.

**What You'll Do**
------------------

### **Own the client relationship**

* Serve as the primary day-to-day point of contact for multiple influencer and celebrity accounts across Zoom, email, and Slack.
* Lead weekly status calls and client meetings, and send same-day recaps with clear next steps, owners, and deadlines.
* Know your clients’ brands, products, retail calendars, and stakeholders cold, and build relationships they trust.
* Manage expectations proactively: flag risks early, present solutions, and keep clients informed before they have to ask.
* Pull together campaign data, content, and results for client reviews, QBRs, and milestone presentations.

* Own campaign timelines from kickoff through final reporting, so every program is delivered on time and aligned with client objectives.
* Build and maintain project management tools and trackers (AirTable, Asana, or similar) that give the team and clients a single source of truth.
* Track every moving piece: creator outreach, contracts, product shipments, content drafts, client approvals, go-live dates, and usage windows.
* Coordinate across Brilliant’s strategy, talent, paid media, PR, social, and analytics teams to keep integrated campaigns in sync.
* Ensure every program meets FTC disclosure guidelines and brand safety standards.
* Keep creator issues to a minimum, and handle the ones that arise calmly and quickly.

### **Manage the money**

* Own influencer budgets on assigned accounts: track talent spend, gifting, product costs, fees, and paid amplification against approved budgets.
* Build and maintain budget trackers and flag overages or underspend before they become problems.
* Lead monthly billing reconciliation with finance, making sure creator payments, invoices, and client billing match.
* Provide inputs on account profitability and scope, and raise when work is drifting out of scope.

### **Lead and develop the team**

* Oversee specialists and coordinators on campaign execution, and set the standard for client correspondence, follow-through, and attention to detail.
* Mentor junior team members: what training do they need, and how can we encourage their growth?
* Help build and improve the client management processes, templates, and playbooks that let the team scale without sacrificing quality.

### **Stay sharp**

* Keep a pulse on TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, Facebook, Pinterest, and emerging platforms, and share trends with clients and the team.
* Bring energy to brainstorms and push the team to think bigger.

**Our Dream Team Member**
-------------------------

* 5–7 years of client service or account management experience, with at least 3 years in influencer marketing.
* Experience in a high-volume influencer agency setting, managing many creators and multiple brands at once. Large-agency experience strongly preferred.
* A deep understanding of influencer budgets: talent rates, fees, gifting, usage rights, whitelisting costs, and how they roll up to a client budget.
* Experience leading monthly billing reconciliation and tracking account profitability.
* Hyper-organized. You build the tracker, you live in the tracker, and you never miss a deadline.
* Fluency in project management tools such as AirTable or Asana, plus familiarity with CreatorIQ, HypeAuditor, Shopify Collabs, or similar platforms.
* Working knowledge of paid, gifted, affiliate, and ambassador programs, plus whitelisting, Spark Ads, and Partnership Ads.
* Experience overseeing or mentoring junior team members.
* Excellent written and verbal communication, with composure and confidence on camera in client meetings.
* Can manage up, manage down, and keep a million moving pieces running smoothly.
* Resourceful, committed, deliberate, and genuinely enjoys crossing things off the list.

### **Bonus Points**

* Experience with parenting, baby, kids, toy, or family lifestyle brands.
* Experience with celebrity talent partnerships and working with agents, managers, and publicists.
* Experience on integrated campaigns that combine influencer with PR, experiential, or retail activations.

***Edvance is a member-benefit company that helps union members and their families access affordable, career-focused education. We work in the higher education and union/labor spaces. To learn more, visit our website at*** edvancecollegebenefit.com

***This is a fully remote position open to candidates anywhere in the continental U.S.***

**Who is Edvance?**

At Edvance, we’re on a mission to create and inspire access to life-changing education pathways for America’s workers and their families, while minimizing – and often eliminating – out-of-pocket tuition costs.

  

Through partnerships with unions and other member organizations, Edvance connects members to a network of curated accredited colleges and universities that offer discounted tuition and programs built for adult learners.

Through the Union College Benefit powered by Edvance, members and their families get tuition discounts up to 40%, 100% online programs, personalized guidance, and support from unionized Student Success Coordinators.

  

We're partnership-first, not vendor-first, and we exist to solve a real problem: members don't know where to start, unions lack the capacity to manage education partnerships alone, and schools struggle to reach working adults. Edvance changes that — for all three.

**About the Role**

The Marketing Specialist reports to the Director of Marketing. This hands-on role produces B2B and B2C partner marketing, lifecycle campaigns, website content, and CRM work.

You will turn marketing strategy into execution across a growing network of partners. A significant part of the role will be creating marketing materials and campaigns for partner launches while also supporting ongoing B2B marketing to organizational partners and B2C marketing to members and prospective students.

  

This is a great opportunity for someone who enjoys creating and improving. You should be comfortable following a strategy and system while also noticing opportunities to make it more effective or efficient.

  

You will work closely with the Director of Marketing and cross-functional teams, including Partner Development, Partner Management, and Academic Partnership.

**What You’ll Do**

**B2B and B2C Campaigns**

* Execute partner launch campaigns using established strategy and content, and contribute ideas to shape and improve them.
* Provide marketing support during partner onboarding and ongoing partnerships.
* Adapt core messaging to each audience and member mix.
* Own campaign timelines, assets, approval, and execution.

**Lifecycle Marketing**

* Build and run email campaigns, nurture sequences, and seasonal pushes.
* Own day-to-day execution of lifecycle programs.
* Research segments and help shape the angle and build the campaigns.
* Monitor performance and find ways to improve engagement and conversion.

**CRM & Marketing Operations**

* Maintain marketing campaigns, workflows, lists, forms and other marketing assets within HubSpot and systems.
* Use practical applications of AI for research, content development, and other marketing tasks with sound judgement to ensure output remains true to our brand and appropriate for our audiences.

**Content & Digital Marketing**

* Write marketing copy for multiple audiences across email, web, social, partner materials, and campaign assets.
* Support website content updates, SEO/GEO initiatives, social media strategy and agency collaboration.
* Produce on-brand assets in Canva.
* Keep messaging relevant to the audience and consistent to our brand standards.

**Reporting & Optimization**

* Monitor campaign and funnel performance and connect campaign activity to business outcomes.
* Bring insights and recommendations to the Director of Marketing based on campaign and audience performance.

**Qualifications**

* 2–4 years of experience in marketing, communications, digital marketing, lifecycle marketing, or a related field.
* Experience with a CRM or marketing automation platform; HubSpot experience is preferred.
* Experience in a B2B2C marketing environment. Partnership marketing and/or franchise marketing experience is a plus.
* Strong attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines.
* Comfort working with data, segmentation, and campaign performance.
* Resourceful and proactive, comfortable in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment.
* An improvement-oriented mindset. You don't just follow a process because it's always been done that way; you look for ways to make it better.

**You might be a great fit if…**

* You’re a strong writer who can adapt messaging across different audiences and channels.
* You enjoy both the creative and operational sides of marketing.
* You’re curious about new marketing tools, including AI, and know when human judgement matters most.
* You want to grow into a leadership role, and you're comfortable taking direction while building toward more ownership.

  
Additional Information: **Location & Travel**

* Remote, Open to candidates in the continental U.S
* Minimal travel, occasional on-site meetings.

*At 1Password, we’re building the foundation for a safe, productive digital future. We innovated the market-leading enterprise password manager and pioneered Unified Access Management, a new cybersecurity category built for the way people and AI agents work today. *If you're excited about the opportunity to contribute to the digital safety of millions, to work alongside a team of curious, driven individuals, and to solve hard problems in a fast-paced, dynamic environment, then we want to hear from you. Come join us and help shape a safer, simpler digital future.*

As Senior Director, Global Total Rewards, you’ll lead the strategy and delivery of compensation, equity, benefits, and related programs across a global technology organization. You’ll guide an approximately eight-person team, partner with senior leaders and cross-functional stakeholders, and help build scalable, equitable programs that support 1Password’s mission to make it safe for everyone to access the information they need.

**How we’re using AI today**
  
On the People team, we’re using AI intentionally and responsibly as part of how our work gets done. We’re building a shared foundation of AI confidence and capability with the belief that innovation happens best when we learn and experiment together. From drafting communications and synthesizing feedback to automating workflows across the employee lifecycle, we’re embedding AI into our day-to-day operations and the way we collaborate cross-functionally, helping us move quickly and create space for the human moments that matter most.

**What we're looking for:**

* Extensive senior-level experience leading global Total Rewards programs, including compensation, equity, benefits, retirement, and executive compensation.

* Experience guiding Total Rewards strategy and operations through significant organizational growth, evolving governance requirements, or preparation for an initial public offering (IPO) and public-company operations.

* Strong experience advising executives, Compensation Committees, and Boards, with the ability to translate complex analysis into clear recommendations and decisions.

* Deep knowledge of equity strategy and governance, including equity ranges, grant programs, refresh programs, share-pool planning, dilution forecasting, and compensation governance.

* Experience building or evolving job architecture, career levels, pay bands, geographic frameworks, and pay equity practices across multiple markets.

* Experience leading or sponsoring large-scale human resources information systems (HRIS), payroll, compensation technology, or enterprise program implementations, including data migration, integrations, testing, controls, and adoption.

* Experience using artificial intelligence (AI), automation, analytics, or scenario modeling to improve Total Rewards insights, scalability, controls, and employee experience.

**What you can expect:**

* Define the future Total Rewards technology and data ecosystem, including optimization of platforms such as Pave and responsible use of AI, automation, analytics, and self-service capabilities.

* Partner with executive leadership, Finance, Legal, and external advisors on executive compensation strategy, market analysis, incentive design, and Compensation Committee materials.

* Oversee equity strategy, global compensation programs, job architecture, career levels, geographic differentials, pay structures, and pay equity initiatives.

* Set the strategic direction for global benefits, retirement, leave, accommodations, and wellbeing programs while supporting international expansion, acquisitions, audits, regulatory requirements, and operational improvements.

At 1Password, we approach each individual's compensation with a promise of fair market value and internal equity commensurate with experience and specific skill set.
  
  
*This posting is for an existing vacancy.*

  

**Our culture**  
At 1Password, we prioritize collaboration, clear and transparent communication, receptiveness to feedback, and alignment with our core values: keep it simple, lead with honesty, and put people first.
  
  
You’ll be part of a team that challenges the status quo, and is excited to experiment and iterate in search of the best solution. That said, *1Password is not for everyone*. Our work is demanding, we strive for excellence, and the pace is fast. We need people who are keen to take on challenging problems, who seek feedback to grow, and who are driven to make an impact. If you're looking for a place where you can settle into a comfortable routine, this might not be the right fit for you. We’re looking for individuals who are proven experts in their fields, as well as those who are highly adaptable, can thrive in ambiguity and through change, are curious, and above all deliver results.

We are committed to leveraging cutting-edge technology—including AI—to achieve our mission. title: Video Content Producer
description:
Overview:

The Video Content Producer, Marketing & Brand Experience is a creative professional responsible for developing and delivering high-quality video content supporting Lakeview’s consumer marketing, customer education, brand storytelling, and internal communications. Reporting to the Creative Director, this position independently manages the video production lifecycle, including concept development, filming, editing, post-production, and final delivery, exercising creative and technical judgement to produce engaging, accurate, and brand-aligned content.

The role collaborates with the Senior Designer, Lead Copywriter, Marketing leadership, and business stakeholders to develop compelling visual storytelling, proactively recommend content concepts and series, establish scalable production practices, and ensure alignment with brand standards, business objectives, and regulatory requirements.

This is a fully remote position with a salary range of $100,000 to $125,000, plus an annual bonus. You'll also receive our excellent benefits package, which includes medical coverage starting on day one and a company-matched 401(k). Compensation may vary based on experience, location, and other job-related factors.

Responsibilities:

* Develop and execute video production projects from concept through final delivery, including creative treatments, storyboards, production planning, filming, editing, and post-production.
* Evaluate creative objectives and independently determine appropriate production techniques, visual storytelling approaches, and technical solutions to deliver engaging, high-quality video content.
* Operate professional video production equipment, including cameras, lighting, and audio systems, while assessing production environments and resolving technical challenges.
* Direct interviews, executive messages, educational presentations, employee stories, and other productions, guiding on-camera participants to achieve effective delivery and messaging.
* Perform comprehensive post-production, including video editing, color correction, audio mixing, captioning, motion graphics, final quality assurance, and formats aligned with marketing and enterprise priorities.
* Develop polished branded motion graphics, reusable video templates, and visual treatments that maintain consistency with Lakeview’s brand standards.
* Collaborate with the Creative Director, Senior Designer, and Lead Copywriter to develop video concepts, scripts, and multimedia content aligned with marketing and business objectives.
* Produce and adapt assets for consumer acquisition, mortgage education, paid advertising, social media, websites, internal announcements, training, and executive communications.
* Proactively identify and recommend video content opportunities, campaign concepts, and storytelling approaches to enhance customer engagement and brand awareness.
* Establish scalable production workflows, reusable editing templates, equipment recommendations, file naming conventions, and organized footage and asset libraries.
* Manage production schedules, resources, and competing project priorities while establishing efficient workflows, organized asset libraries, and consistent production standards.
* Partner with Legal and Compliance on approved messaging, disclosures, usage rights, and review processes; responsibly evaluate approved AI-assisted production tools.
* Other duties as assigned.

Qualifications:

* Bachelor’s degree in Film, Video Production, Digital Media, Communications, Marketing, or a related field, or equivalent demonstrated professional experience preferred; High school diploma or GED equivalent required.
* Minimum 5 years of professional video production, editing, or multimedia content development experience.
* Strong production portfolio demonstrating high-quality visual storytelling, technical execution, and creative versatility across branded, commercial, educational, or corporate content.
* Demonstrated ability to independently execute the full production lifecycle, including pre-production, filming, post-production, and final delivery.
* Advanced proficiency in Adobe Premiere Pro or comparable professional editing software, with strong working knowledge of After Effects, Audition, and related and emerging tools.
* Strong technical expertise in professional camera systems, lighting, audio recording, video composition, color correction, and post-production.
* Strong working knowledge of branded motion graphics, including titles, lower thirds, transitions, and reusable motion treatments.
* Experience directing interviews and developing video content for digital marketing, social media, advertising, executive communications, and internal audiences.
* Experience adapting content for websites, paid media, social platforms, presentations, and internal communications, including captioning and accessibility requirements.
* Strong organizational, project management, communication, and problem-solving skills with the ability to manage multiple production projects and deadlines.
* Experience in financial services or regulated industries; familiarity with responsible AI-assisted production tools preferred.
* Ability and willingness to travel for scheduled production activities as required, subject to business needs.

*Lakeview is an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. All aspects of consideration for employment and employment with the Company are governed on the basis of merit, competence, and qualifications without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, or any other category protected by federal, state, or local law.*

title: Director, Brand Marketing
description:
As a Director of Brand Marketing, will own the evolution of MongoDB's global brand identity and creative expression. MongoDB isn't just about logos or design systems—it's about driving real business outcomes, translating our complex technical offerings into stories and experiences, and fostering pride and loyalty among all audiences. This is your chance to shape the creative future of one of the fastest-growing enterprise companies in the world.

You will lead and influence all aspects of MongoDB's brand visual expression. You are an articulate champion for design, passionate about quality and craft, and an experienced leader of diverse teams who can elevate ambitious work while delivering outstanding business results. Reporting to the VP of Corporate Marketing, you will work with peer leaders in Marketing and Product to transform the MongoDB brand to drive mindshare and market share with developer and executive audiences.

You are responsible for leading a team of creative professionals and collaborating with marketing, product, and sales to develop marketing plans, analyze results, and identify opportunities. You are also responsible for meeting budget requirements by forecasting and managing expectations.

### **What you'll do:**

Strategic Impact & Vision

* Develop and articulate a bold, clear, and compelling brand strategy that enhances MongoDB's market differentiation, emotional resonance, and business impact with audiences ranging from developers to senior executives
* Translate MongoDB's business priorities into powerful creative concepts and brand campaigns. Partner with executive leadership and cross-functional teams to craft ideas that move both our brand and the business forward
* Identify and resolve strategic challenges by innovating bold, creative solutions that drive transformation and brand loyalty
* Establish operational goals and metrics to measure awareness, emotional resonance, loyalty, and business outcomes—and implement mechanisms to continuously optimize MongoDB's brand performance globally

Creative Leadership & Brand Development

* Push the boundaries of our brand expression—from timeless visual systems to innovative campaigns—delivering emotional, human-centered work while staying connected to MongoDB's technical roots
* Lead narrative-driven storytelling across a variety of mediums (digital, video, events, product experiences, swag, etc.). Make technical complexity feel engaging, empowering, and relatable
* Stay ahead of emerging creative technologies, including AI, generative design, motion, and interactive storytelling. Leverage these tools not just for efficiency, but to unlock bold, new creative possibilities
* Build for digital-first experiences across platforms. Think intuitively about feeds, formats, and moments, creating a brand presence designed for today's fast-moving, online world
* Lead the refresh of our brand foundation and visual identity, ensuring MongoDB's design system is distinct, scalable, and future-ready

Team Leadership & Collaboration

* Recruit, mentor, and inspire a multidisciplinary creative team of designers, content creators, illustrators, and more, fostering a culture of excellence and inclusion where bold ideas thrive
* Champion a culture of creativity and collaboration, driving strong concept development, attention to craft, and team cohesion
* Build partnerships across Product, Marketing, Employee Experience, and Corporate Communications to ensure brand consistency and cohesion across all touchpoints
* Serve as a key brand ambassador internally and externally, confidently articulating MongoDB's brand vision to executives, employees, and the wider ecosystem

Executional Excellence

* Deliver scalable, high-impact creative campaigns and brand experiences that resonate with developers and executive audiences alike
* Manage resources, timelines, and budgets with strategic efficiency that maximizes ROI while ensuring quality and innovation across projects
* Set a high bar for creative output, inspiring teams to raise the standard for storytelling, emotional connection, and visual expression at MongoDB
* Experiment boldly across digital, live events, swag, and interactive environments to create unforgettable experiences that make "using MongoDB" synonymous with belonging to something bigger

### **What you'll bring to the table:**

* Elevate our storytelling in product and company narratives through clear and compelling visual designs and elements
* Develop and articulate a compelling design vision and operational strategy aligned with MongoDB's goals
* Develop and maintain strong relationships with internal stakeholders and external partners to align creative work with business objectives and achieve pull-through across brands' platforms. This includes centralizing brand information, guidelines, collaboration tools, and digital asset management to ensure consistent brand communication
* Present design concepts and strategies to senior leadership, influencing decisions and direction. Through regular reviews and meetings, ensure clarity and consistent workflow
* Communicate effectively with cross-functional teams to ensure successful project buy-in and execution
* Track industry trends and best practices, bringing innovative ideas back into MongoDB
* Maintain and model a high bar for quality and taste
* Prioritize work and resources across engagements based on short- and long-term needs and develop schedules by collaborating with designers, copywriters, and production artists
* Conduct brainstorming sessions with the creative team, maintaining strategic thinking to develop innovative and actionable initiatives in a fiscally responsible manner
* Review and approve art and copy developed by the team, ensuring that deliverables effectively address marketing goals and challenges
* Lead creative and design direction for brand initiatives, ensuring consistency and excellence
* Inspire, mentor, and lead a diverse team of design practitioners, fostering a culture of excellence, creativity, and collaboration
* Direct multiple projects, stakeholders, and budgets within deadlines. Manage budgets efficiently, maximizing ROI

### **Required skills and qualifications**

* 10+ years of design leadership in an external agency and/or internal brand team
* Experience crafting and operationalizing branding and design systems for B2B, technology/SaaS brands across print, digital, video, etc. Experience working at or with databases, data analytics, data science, or similar products is a plus
* Leadership of creative production and execution of large in-person events and marketing campaign design alike
* Proven ability to develop successful concepts
* Strong creative vision with an eye on business objectives
* Experience in creating integrated content across all marketing channels: digital, social media, paid media, mobile, offline, and print
* Experience recruiting, retaining, and growing a team of diverse, talented creatives
* Excellent creative management skills with the ability to effortlessly meet deadlines on multiple projects with varying timelines
* Experience working in a fast-paced, high-volume, deadline-oriented environment
* Experience collaborating with cross-discipline senior stakeholders
* Experience pitching ideas that articulate a strategic design approach
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills
* A positive, kind team player with an optimistic, enthusiastic attitude who's able to collaborate with and influence peers to overcome obstacles

Preferred skills and qualifications

* Bachelor's degree (or equivalent) in marketing or business
* Experience as a copywriter, graphic designer, or production artist
* Experience in project management, with a focus on creative direction

### **About MongoDB**

MongoDB is built for change, empowering our customers and our people to innovate at the speed of the market. We have redefined the data platform for the AI era, enabling builders to create, transform, and disrupt industries with software. MongoDB's unified data platform, the most widely available, globally distributed data platform on the market, helps organizations modernize legacy workloads, embrace innovation, and unleash AI. Our cloud-native platform, MongoDB Atlas, is the only globally distributed, multi-cloud data platform and is available across AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure.

With offices worldwide and over 67,000 customers, including AI-native startups and approximately 75% of the Fortune 100, relying on MongoDB for their most important applications, we're powering the next era of software.

Our compass at MongoDB is our Leadership Commitment, guiding how and why we make decisions, show up for each other, and win. It's what makes us MongoDB.

To drive the personal growth and business impact of our employees, we're committed to developing a supportive and enriching culture for everyone. From employee affinity groups, to fertility assistance and a generous parental leave policy, we value our employees' wellbeing and want to support them along every step of their professional and personal journeys. title: Director, Marketing Communications
description:
At Zimmer Biomet, we believe in pushing the boundaries of innovation and driving our mission forward. As a global medical technology leader for nearly 100 years, a patient’s mobility is enhanced by a Zimmer Biomet product or technology every 8 seconds.

As a Zimmer Biomet team member, you will share in our commitment to providing mobility and renewed life to people around the world. To support our talent team, we focus on development opportunities, robust employee resource groups (ERGs), a flexible working environment, location specific competitive total rewards, wellness incentives and a culture of recognition and performance awards. We are committed to creating an environment where every team member feels included, respected, empowered, and recognized.

**What You Can Expect**
-----------------------

Reporting to the Vice President of External Communications, the Director, Marketing Communications leads a team that translates complex innovation into bold, clear campaigns and promotional tactics across Zimmer Biomet’s hip, knee, upper extremities, sports medicine and technology portfolio. You’ll coach a team and give them room to experiment, challenge convention and turn the strongest ideas into campaigns that connect our technology and products to the needs of surgeons and patients to build demand and support sales. You’ll make sure surgeon, HCP and/or patient perspectives come through in our stories, then use clear measures to show what is working and where campaigns can improve. This is an opportunity for a creative leader who pairs imagination with insight and can show how great marketing communication moves the business forward.

**How You'll Create Impact**
----------------------------

* Own the marketing communications strategy for Zimmer Biomet's knee, hip, upper extremities, sports medicine and technology portfolio, ensuring all content and message development is aligned with business strategy and corporate brand goals
* Partner with business unit Marketing to convert business and product strategy into clear creative briefs that ultimately develop into campaigns and/or strategies that generate demand and increase sales.
* Develop campaigns, messaging frameworks, narratives, videos and proof points for the company's portfolio and serve as the authority on messaging to external audiences on our products. Translate robotics, AI, data analytics and implant capabilities into clear, evidence-based stories that help surgeons understand how these tools can support decisions for each case.
* Build and communicate strategy to the team, business partners and senior leaders, creating clarity on priorities, trade-offs, resourcing and expected business outcomes.
* Define and report campaign and product-program metrics tied to commercial goals. Use data, customer insights and competitive intelligence to refine messaging, channel mix and investment decisions, and show how the work contributes to product demand and sales.
* Coordinate interviews and voice of customer sessions with surgeon customers to bring their perspectives into product stories and campaigns. Develop surgeon testimonials and other third-party endorsement strategies in partnership with Legal, Regulatory and Compliance, with appropriate permissions, substantiation and disclosures.
* Ensure alignment of strategic communication plans across business units and identify new cross-portfolio and cross-functional opportunities that increase brand awareness and market share.
* Lead the overarching surgeon- and HCP-facing content integration strategy across print, digital, social and event channels, and oversee the promotional presence for assigned business units, including review and approval of content.
* Lead marketing communications for product launches, clinical and evidence milestones and major congresses, and serve as the marketing communications management approval within the NPI/Business
* Review Checkpoint/Tollgate process, ensuring resources and tasks are assigned to clear each Checkpoint.
* Ensure all content is consistent with Zimmer Biomet brand positioning, architecture and visual identity, and compliant with applicable regulatory, legal and industry advertising and promotion requirements.
* Collaborate with internal cross-functional partners, including Leadership, to influence and align product messaging across all channels.
* Maintain controls, systems and standards that govern marketing and informational materials.
* Manage spend including agency and vendor partnerships, ensuring the right balance of internal and external resources to deliver projects on time and within budget.
* Manage, develop and upskill the team, mentoring in strategy and message development and sustaining an empowered, positive work environment across a distributed team.
* Maintain a high level of industry and communications knowledge to keep Zimmer Biomet brands relevant and gaining share.

***\*\*This is not an exhaustive list of duties or functions and might not necessarily comprise all of the essential functions for purposes of the Americans with Disabilities Act.***

**What Makes You Stand Out**
----------------------------

* Strategic Communications Leadership: Ability to think strategically and translate complex business, clinical and technical information into clear, differentiated messaging and integrated communication plans that advance portfolio and enterprise objectives.
* MedTech Market and Regulatory Acumen: Knowledge of the orthopedic/MedTech market, surgical and selling processes, and the development and regulatory environment, including evidence-based claims and advertising and promotional review requirements.
* Execution Excellence: Excellent organizational and program management skills, with the ability to handle many issues independently and prioritize accordingly; consistently supports timely execution with precision and within budget while sustaining a longer-term strategic view.
* People Leadership and Development: Skilled at building, coaching and upskilling teams and mentoring communications leads, particularly in developing direct reports' strategic thinking and messaging capabilities, and at leading effectively in a fully remote environment.
* Influence and Cross-Functional Partnership: Exceptional written and verbal communication skills with demonstrated ability to influence and lead cross-functional, multi-disciplined teams, clearly convey information, and inspire confidence in internal and external stakeholders at all levels.
* Customer Insight: Ability to bring surgeon and customer perspectives into campaigns, develop compliant testimonials and third-party endorsement strategies.
* Campaign Measurement and Optimization: Experience in setting clear objectives, tracking campaign performance against commercial goals, and adjusting strategy, messaging or channel mix when results fall short of expectations.

**Education and Experience**
----------------------------

* Bachelor's Degree and 8 years of relevant experience, or Associate's Degree and 10 years of relevant experience, or High School Diploma or Equivalent and 12 years of relevant experience required
* 2 years of experience as a people manager required; 3+ years with direct reports is strongly preferred

description:

The Director will be responsible for planning, development and implementation of marketing strategy , communications, innovation, renovation and portfolio management to exceed stated volume and profit objectives .
  
  
The Marketing Director will oversee all aspects of Top Ramen® across all platforms, formats and sub-brands under Top Ramen.

* Understands relevant marketplace dynamics and other key issues that help the team in the development of the brand's marketing mix (e.g., product quality, pricing, promotions, and distribution).

* 3+ years managing direct reports

**Preferred**

USD $180,000.00 - USD $210,000.00 /Yr.

OUR FOUNDER, MOMOFUKU ANDO
