title: Head of Performance Video
description:
### **Description**

**About Rho**  
  
Rho Nutrition was founded to bring integrity and innovation to supplement manufacturing by prioritizing medically studied, high-quality formulations. Our products feature clinically proven ingredients using next-generation bio-delivery technologies to enhance cellular-level absorption and drive measurable health benefits. Founded with the vision to deliver unparalleled cellular absorption, we focus on transparency, effectiveness, and empowering individuals to understand and optimize their supplementation. Rho is committed to advancing the science behind wellness and helping customers invest in their health with efficacy-driven solutions. Operating across Shopify DTC, Amazon, and national retail, Rho serves hundreds of thousands of customers and is scaling rapidly while maintaining our strict standards.

**Role Overview**  
  
We’re hiring a Head of Performance Video to lead Rho’s video editing department. You’ll manage and develop our editors, own the quality and delivery of their work, and personally edit performance video.

Reporting to the VP of Creative and Growth and working directly with the founder, you’ll turn creative briefs and direction into effective ads. You’ll lead day-to-day editing, give clear feedback, solve problems in the work, and keep projects moving from raw footage to final delivery.

You’ll stay hands-on, owning edits yourself while helping the team improve. You’ll also contribute to creative strategy discussions and use performance results to sharpen editorial decisions, ensuring the intended audience, message, and testing objective carry through into every cut.

**What You'll Own**  
  
**Lead and develop the video team**

* Manage, coach, and grow a team of video editors, including hiring, onboarding, regular one-to-ones, and performance development.
* Set clear expectations for quality, ownership, and delivery. Give specific, constructive feedback that helps editors become stronger creative thinkers.
* Plan assignments around team capacity and individual strengths, with clear priorities and coverage when people are unavailable.
* Build a collaborative environment where people can contribute ideas, ask questions early, and raise problems before they affect delivery.

**Edit hands-on and lead editorial quality**

* Personally edit priority ads from raw footage through final delivery, including creator, expert, founder, podcast, and product content. Maintain your own editing workload alongside team leadership.
* Find the strongest moments in the footage and build clear, persuasive stories around them. Make thoughtful decisions about hooks, structure, pacing, product explanation, proof, and calls to action.
* Preserve each creator’s voice, personality, and natural delivery. Know when a simple phone video needs restraint and when a produced piece benefits from more craft.
* Use B-roll, graphics, captions, sound, and AI tools deliberately. Every element should help the viewer understand or believe the message.
Review the team’s edits before stakeholder review, give precise notes, and demonstrate solutions directly in the timeline. Partner with Design on typography, composition, and motion standards.  

**Own the editing workflow and delivery**

* Own the editing pipeline from brief and footage review through revisions, quality checks, and delivery. Confirm that each editor understands the direction and deliverables before work begins.
* Flag missing footage or unclear direction early, and work with Creative Strategy, Production, and Partnerships to resolve gaps.
* Work with Creative Operations to keep priorities, owners, deadlines, review status, and launch handoffs clear. Consolidate feedback and proactively resolve blockers.
* Build repeatable standards for project files, naming, version control, and searchable footage libraries so editors can find and reuse strong material.
Coordinate with science, compliance, and partner teams on approved claims, disclosures, and usage permissions. Ensure final assets meet the relevant channel specifications.  

**Contribute to strategy and apply performance learnings**

* Work with the VP of Creative and Growth and creative strategists to understand each brief’s audience, angle, message, and test objective. Ensure those choices are carried through in the edit.
* Contribute ideas in creative reviews, including stronger openings, alternative story structures, useful footage, and opportunities for new cuts. Bring an editor’s perspective to briefing and shoot planning.
* Review ad performance with Creative Strategy and Paid Media. Understand hook rate, hold rate, CTR, conversion rate, CPA/CAC, and ROAS, and use the results to inform editing decisions.
* Turn agreed learnings into purposeful iterations, such as a clearer product explanation, stronger proof, a different opening, or a tighter story. Help editors understand what each version is testing.
* Share patterns from winning and underperforming edits with the team. Evaluate results in context, including spend and campaign objective, and connect attention metrics with conversion outcomes.

  

### **What You'll Bring**

  

* Relevant experience editing performance video at a consumer brand or an agency serving consumer brands is required. You must have directly worked on paid social advertising, with strong experience creating video for Meta.
* Proven experience managing and developing video editors**.** You’ve owned team output, improved creative quality, and helped people become more capable and independent.
* Excellent hands-on editing skills in Premiere Pro or comparable software, with the technical depth to coach others on pacing, sound, color, typography, and motion.
* A portfolio of direct-response ads you have personally edited, with a clear explanation of your contribution, the editorial choices you made, and available performance results.
* Strong creative judgment across authentic creator content and polished production, with an understanding of how each earns attention and builds trust.
* A practical understanding of creative strategy and direct-response storytelling, including audience needs, problem and solution framing, product benefits, proof, and offers.
* Strong understanding of advertising performance. You can read creative reports, interpret key metrics in context, and explain how the results should influence the next edit.
* Clear communication and proactive ownership. You can work directly with senior leaders, challenge ideas constructively, and turn feedback into action.
* Experience in supplements, health, wellness, beauty, or another category that requires careful product education is a plus. Experience with TikTok and YouTube creative, expert or athlete talent, and distributed editing teams is also valuable.

### **What Does Success Look Like in This Role**

  

* A team that understands the strategy, receives useful coaching, and delivers stronger work with greater independence.
* Strong edits that accurately execute the creative brief, preserve the talent’s authenticity, and make the product’s relevance clear.
* Evidence that performance learnings are improving hooks, storytelling, and subsequent iterations, in partnership with Creative Strategy and Paid Media.
* Faster turnaround, fewer avoidable revision rounds, and clear visibility into what is ready, blocked, and launching next.
* A hands-on department leader who produces strong work personally and resolves day-to-day editing decisions with confidence.
* You’ll agree goals with the VP of Creative and Growth covering editing quality, reliable output, turnaround, avoidable revision rounds, team development, and the performance of the work.

  

### **Why Join Rho Nutrition**

At Rho Nutrition, you’ll be part of a team that is passionate about helping people live healthier, stronger lives through evidence-based nutrition. We believe great work happens when talented people are empowered to innovate, collaborate, and grow. Joining Rho means contributing to a mission-driven company that values integrity, curiosity, and continuous improvement—while giving you the opportunity to make a real impact on the health and performance of the communities we serve. If you’re motivated by purpose and excited to work alongside people who care deeply about results and relationships, Rho Nutrition is a place where your work truly matters.

  

### **About Rho Nutrition**

We specialize in delivering innovative solutions and exceptional services to meet the diverse needs of our clients. With a strong commitment to quality and customer satisfaction, we strive to exceed expectations and drive success in every project we undertake.

title: Head of YouTube (Strategy, Scripting & Team Lead)
description:
**IMPORTANT PLEASE READ THE FULL APPLICATION CAREFULLY. IF YOU MISS ANY OF THE ANSWER FIELDS YOU WILL BE AUTOMATICALLY DISQUALIFIED.**  
  
We're hiring a **Head of YouTube** to lead Richard Yu's channels and creative team. Richard teaches people how to build businesses selling digital and physical products through "AI Arbitrage"

### **✅ The challenge**

Our immediate goal is to grow the business channel from ~90,000 to 200,000+ subscribers in six months and bring average views per video above 100,000. These are aggressive goals. We want someone excited by that challenge, with a clear approach to choosing what to make, testing ideas and getting good videos out consistently.

You'll grow the top of the funnel by reaching new viewers who fit our audience. You'll also plan content for viewers who are getting to know Richard, learning about our offers and deciding whether to buy. Ultimately, we want this channel to grow the business, so views and subscribers need to translate into an audience we can serve.

You'll be responsible for what we make, why we make it, how we package and produce it, and whether it worked. You'll work directly with Richard and the leadership team to set direction, goals and KPI's and lead, hire and manage a creative team underneath.

**This is a senior creative strategist and operator role**.
  
  
You will write first-person, long-form scripts yourself, as well as review and improve other writers' work. You should be equally comfortable setting channel direction, giving specific feedback and getting videos published.

### **✅ What you'll own**

* **Strategy and ideation:** own the channel's growth goals, metrics and KPIs. Turn them into a clear plan for topics, formats and ideas, based on what our audience cares about and what we can learn from videos that perform well above their channel's usual results. Plan videos that bring in new viewers, build trust and help the right people take the next step.
* **Testing and learning:** build structured tests with a clear hypothesis, a useful comparison and defined success measures. Decide which tests are worth running, make sense of the results and apply what you learn to the next videos.
* **Packaging:** titles, thumbnail concepts and briefs, A/B tests, and repackaging decisions informed by CTR, retention and traffic sources.
* **Scripting:** write full scripts when needed, and edit and quality-check every script before Richard films it. Build strong hooks, story structure, pacing, curiosity and payoffs that keep people watching. Deliver the title's promise in a natural voice, with concrete examples and verified claims.
* **Production:** give editors specific feedback from the first cut, set clear standards and make sure each video meets them.
* **Analytics:** review what worked, what didn't and what to change next. Track subscriber growth, views and audience quality alongside the channel's contribution to leads and sales, working with the wider marketing team. Be clear about which results we can attribute to YouTube and where we’re still making assumptions.
* **Team:** hire, onboard and manage editors, designers and writers. Coach people to improve and write procedures and checklists that help the team make good decisions independently.

### **✅ Who will do well here**

You have a deep passion for YouTube (storytelling and psychology), and an understanding of channel growth. You can explain why a topic, format, title, thumbnail or script works: what earns the click, what keeps someone watching and what makes them return. You can turn that understanding into work that performs.

You are excited about taking on ambitious goals and being responsible for the results. You track progress honestly, work out what's holding us back and come with ideas for fixing it. You learn quickly, ask for feedback and change your approach when the evidence calls for it.

Strong business judgment, an understanding of marketing funnels and experience in Infopreneurship, online education or Edutech are major advantages. We’ll weigh that experience heavily. We’ll also consider an exceptional YouTube leader who can learn our audience, offers and funnel quickly.

This is a full-time role for someone who wants to focus on one business and take responsibility for both the creative work and the team.

### **✅ Hiring process**

Application, Zoom call, paid test project, final interview, offer. For your application, share existing work you are allowed to share; no new script or channel audit is required at this stage.

### **✅ How to apply**

Review Richard’s business YouTube channel and browse the other channels/accounts linked there for context.
  
  
**IMPORTANT TO BE CONSIDERED YOU MUST SHARE A 3–5 MINUTE VIDEO COVERING:**

**1. Your background and motivation:** Briefly introduce yourself, your role on the YouTube channels you’ve worked on and the results you’re most proud of. What excites you about this opportunity, and why do you want this particular role working with Richard Yu?

**2. Your growth philosophy:** How do you approach growing a business YouTube channel like ours? Which metrics matter most, and why?

**3. Your read on our channel and your first 30 days:** What are we doing well, and what most needs to improve to reach 200k+ subscribers in six months and average over 100k views per video? Briefly explain your reasoning and what you would focus on in your first 30 days. Tell us what you can judge from the public channel and what you’d need to learn from our analytics or team. One or two meaningful observations are enough.

**4. Your leadership:** What creative teams have you led? Share one brief example of a difficult leadership decision, how you handled it and what happened.

Keep it conversational and focus on what matters most. You don’t need slides, a detailed audit or a strategy deck. We want to understand you, your judgment and how you work. Please check that your Loom link is accessible.

 **Requirements**  

* + - * + - * + **You’ve grown a YouTube channel and can show the results and your contribution.** We strongly prefer experience in business, making money online, finance or startups. We’ll also consider strong results in tech, personal growth, edutainment or entertainment.
              + Deep passion for YouTube and demonstrated understanding of storytelling and channel growth. Show us published long-form work and explain what you contributed.
              + Strong creative judgment across topics, formats, ideation, titles and thumbnails. You can explain why people click, keep watching and return.
              + Deep understanding of a winning script: hooks, narrative structure, pacing, curiosity, clear explanations and satisfying payoffs. Ability and willingness to write complete first-person, talking-head scripts and improve another writer's work.
              + A structured approach to testing: clear hypotheses, useful comparisons, defined success measures and sound interpretation of results.
              + Ownership of goals, metrics and KPIs. Strong command of CTR, average view duration, retention graphs, traffic sources and channel growth metrics, with examples of how you used them to make decisions.
              + Experience managing editors and/or designers, setting clear standards, giving specific feedback and helping people improve.
              + You learn quickly, ask good questions and take direct feedback well. You can get up to speed on a new audience, subject and business model.
              + Strong business judgment and experience with marketing funnels, infopreneurship, online education or edusoftware are highly valued. A record of connecting content to leads or sales is a strong advantage. These are not prerequisites for an exceptional YouTube candidate who can learn this side quickly.
              + Fluent spoken and written English is essential. You must be able to write natural, compelling English scripts and communicate clearly with Richard and the team.
              + Confidence using without over-reliance on AI tools, particularly Claude/Codex. You still take responsibility for the voice, accuracy and claims in the finished work.
              + Full-time availability and at least 4 hours of overlap with US Eastern working hours.
              + Remote: we welcome candidates across the United States, Canada, the UK, Europe, Mexico, Central America and South America, including Spain, Portugal, France, Germany, the Netherlands, Poland, Brazil, Panama, Colombia, Argentina and Costa Rica. Exceptional candidates elsewhere are also welcome. What matters is strong YouTube judgment, fluent English and reliable overlap with US Eastern working hours.

  
**Benefits**  

* + **A meaningful challenge.** Help grow a brand with audacious goals, including taking our business channel to 200k+ subscribers in six months and averaging over 100k views per video. Your work will directly shape how we reach people, earn their trust and grow the business.
  + **Real ownership and influence.** We value input from everyone, and few things are off-limits to thoughtful questioning. Bring your perspective, question assumptions and propose better approaches. We listen to good reasoning and are willing to change direction when the evidence supports it. Your ideas and what you learn through testing can influence the broader business.

title: Director, Product Design
description:
****🚀 Join the Future of Commerce with Whatnot!****
Whatnot is the largest live shopping platform in North America and Europe to buy, sell, and discover the things you love. Whether it's trading cards, fashion, electronics, or live plants, our sellers are building real businesses across hundreds of categories. We're building live commerce at a scale that's never been done in the West, and there's no playbook to copy. The people here are shaping how an entirely new industry develops.
  
  
As a remote co-located team, we're inspired by our values and anchored in hubs across the US, UK, Ireland, Poland, Germany, and Australia. We move fast, stay close to our users, and focus on the work that drives the most impact.
  
  
We're one of the fastest growing marketplaces and were recently named the #1 Best Startup Employer in America by Forbes. Check out the latest Whatnot updates on our news and engineering blogs and join us as we enable anyone to turn their passion into a business and bring people together through commerce.
  
  
**About The Role**
We’re looking for a strategic and inspiring Director of Product Design to lead our Buyer Design team, the group responsible for shaping the end-to-end experience for millions of users navigating our platform.
  
  
As the design leader overseeing the entire buyer journey, you'll drive the strategy and execution for everything from customer acquisition, activation, to retention and re-engagement. This includes onboarding, discovery surfaces (browse, search, ranking, personalization, taxonomy), the live shopping experience, customer service, our games team, and customer service flows.
  
  
You’ll be a true player-coach, equally comfortable building and developing a high-performing design team as you are rolling up your sleeves and doing the work yourself. You’ll help shape the team, establish clear career paths, mentor designers, and create an environment where people can grow and do their best work.
  
  
As a leader, you’ll help define the design strategy and set a clear vision for what our experiences can become, partnering closely with product, engineering, research, and business teams to turn that vision into a roadmap for the team.
  
  
As a practitioner, you’ll stay close to the work. You’ll move fluidly from defining the long-term experience vision to tackling specific product and feature-level design challenges - exploring concepts, prototyping ideas, and helping bring the details to life. This role is for someone who can lead through both direction and craft, knowing when to empower the team and when to jump in and design alongside them.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Lead and scale a high-performing team of product designers across the buyer funnel.
* Define and drive the vision, strategy, and execution for the buyer experience in collaboration with cross-functional partners.
* Partner with research, data, and product to develop deep customer empathy and inform high-impact design decisions.
* Shape intuitive, elegant systems across discovery, live shopping, and post-purchase experiences.
* Ensure our experiences are accessible, inclusive, and delightfully human.
* Champion design quality and consistency across surfaces while enabling speed and iteration.
* Nurture a strong design culture through mentorship, feedback, and high standards for craft and thinking.
* Represent design in executive conversations and influence company-wide priorities.

**What We’re Looking For**

* 10+ years of product design experience, with at least 3+ years leading teams.
* A player-coach mindset-excited to mentor, but equally passionate about designing and solving problems hands-on.
* Strong portfolio showcasing interaction and visual design skills, with a track record of shipping successful products.
* Proven success designing and scaling customer-facing experiences across a complex funnel (acquisition through retention).
* Deep expertise in interaction design, systems thinking, and user-centered design.
* Strong understanding of search, discovery, personalization, and taxonomy design principles.
* Experience in e-commerce, marketplaces, or live shopping platforms is a major plus.
* A strong collaborator who thrives at the intersection of product, business, and user needs.
* A portfolio that demonstrates thoughtful, elegant solutions to complex problems.

**Why You’ll Love This Role**
You’ll help define how the next generation of users discover, shop, and engage with sellers and communities they love. You’ll work alongside a passionate and ambitious team that values joy, experimentation, and deep customer empathy. And you’ll help build a design culture where creativity and performance go hand in hand.
  
  
If you’re an experienced design leader who loves craft, strategy, and collaboration, we’d love to hear from you!
  
  
****Reporting Structure****
Jon Malkemus - VP of Design

We believe that our work is better and our company culture is improved when we encourage, support, and respect the different skills and experiences represented within our workforce.
